			for _, t in ipairs(chainBucket) do pcall(task.cancel, t) end
			Particle.ActiveChainLoops[item] = nil
		end
		item:SetAttribute("AnimateLoop", false)
		local gen = (item:GetAttribute("_emitGen") or 0) + 1
		pcall(function() item:SetAttribute("_emitGen", gen) end)
		if hard then cancelAnimation(self, item) end
		local config = TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
		if config then config:SetAttribute("Enabled", false) end
		pcall(function() item:SetAttribute("_PartIclePlaying", nil) end)
		for _, desc in ipairs(item:GetDescendants()) do
			if desc:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
				if hard then self:Disable(desc) else self:SoftDisable(desc) end
			elseif desc:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or desc:IsA("Trail") then
				if hard then ParticlesMod.CancelNative(desc) else pcall(function() desc.Enabled = false end) end
			elseif desc:IsA("Beam") or desc:IsA("Highlight") then
				pcall(function() desc.Enabled = false end)
			end
		end
	end

	-- Hard stop: halt emission AND reclaim every live clone now (sweep ActiveEmits + finish
	-- linger). Waypoint pair (Studio edit only; standalone-runtime skips it) makes the whole
	-- disable one undo step.
	function Particle:Disable(item)
		if not item then return end
		local CHS = IS_PLUGIN and game:GetService("RunService"):IsEdit() and game:GetService("ChangeHistoryService") or nil
		if CHS then CHS:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Disable") end
		haltEmission(self, item, true)
		-- Reclaim live one-shots (backward walk = swap-and-pop safe); _releaseOrDestroy pools
		-- eligible visuals instead of cold-destroying them.
		local active = self.ActiveEmits
		for idx = #active, 1, -1 do
			local pData = active[idx]
			if pData and pData._sourceItem == item then
				if pData.VisualPart and pData.VisualPart.Parent then
					self:_releaseOrDestroy(pData, pData.VisualPart)
				end
				if pData._scaleMapKeys and self._parentScaleMap then
					for _, desc in ipairs(pData._scaleMapKeys) do
						self._parentScaleMap[desc] = nil
					end
				end
				local n = #active
				if idx < n then active[idx] = active[n] end
				active[n] = nil
			end
		end
		-- Finish PartLife linger clones early; _lingerCounted guards a double-decrement.
		if self._lingerByItem and self._lingerByItem[item] then
			for _, visualPart in ipairs(self._lingerByItem[item]) do
				if visualPart then
					local counted = false
					pcall(function() counted = visualPart:GetAttribute("_lingerCounted") == true end)
					if counted then
						self._lingerVisualCount = math.max(0, (self._lingerVisualCount or 0) - 1)
						pcall(function() visualPart:SetAttribute("_lingerCounted", nil) end)
					end
					if visualPart.Parent then
						pcall(function() visualPart:Destroy() end)
					end
				end
			end
			self._lingerByItem[item] = nil
		end
		if CHS then CHS:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Disable") end
	end

	-- Skip descendants under a nested Transformed item (recursion reaches them separately).
	local function _hasTransformedAncestor(desc, root)
		local p = desc.Parent
		while p and p ~= root do
			if p:GetAttribute("Transformed") then return true end
			p = p.Parent
		end
		return false
	end

	-- Recursive enable. Walks `item` + descendants:
	--   - Transformed item → cfg.Enabled=true + :Enable(math.huge). Sets _PartIclePlaying
	--     first so the EnabledLoop listener bails (prevents double-Enable / 1-frame pop).
	--   - Raw PE / Trail / Beam → .Enabled=true.
	--   - Container → walks descendants once, recurses children with `_parentCovered` so raw
	--     descendants don't double-toggle.
	function Particle:AbsoluteEnable(item, _parentCovered)
		if not item then return end
		if item:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
			-- Set _PartIclePlaying BEFORE flipping cfg.Enabled so EnabledLoop.handleToggle
			-- bails on the attribute change (it gates on _PartIclePlaying). Otherwise the
			-- direct Enable below and the listener's handleToggle both spawn loopBody,
			-- causing a cancel+restart pop on every AbsoluteEnable call (visible 1-frame
			-- artifact on Animate mode, off-by-one emit shift on Emit mode). Particle:Disable
			-- clears the attribute on the matching AbsoluteDisable.
			pcall(function() item:SetAttribute("_PartIclePlaying", true) end)
			local config = TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
			if config then config:SetAttribute("Enabled", true) end
			-- Direct Enable call covers standalone-runtime (no listener to react to attribute).
			self:Enable(item, nil, math.huge)
			return
		end
		if item:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or item:IsA("Trail") or item:IsA("Beam") then
			if _parentCovered then return end
			pcall(function() item.Enabled = true end)
			return
		end
		local shouldCover = (item:IsA("BasePart") or item:IsA("Attachment") or item:IsA("Model")) and not _parentCovered
		if shouldCover then
			for _, desc in ipairs(item:GetDescendants()) do
				if (desc:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or desc:IsA("Trail") or desc:IsA("Beam"))
					and not desc:GetAttribute("Transformed")
					and not _hasTransformedAncestor(desc, item) then
					pcall(function() desc.Enabled = true end)
				end
			end
		end
		local covered = shouldCover or _parentCovered
		for _, child in item:GetChildren() do
			if item:IsA("BasePart") and child:IsA("BasePart") and not child:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
				continue
			end
			self:AbsoluteEnable(child, covered)
		end
	end

	-- Soft stop: halt new emission but leave live clones for the Heartbeat to age out (no
	-- ActiveEmits sweep, no linger destroy, no cancelAnimation) so on-screen clones finish
	-- their Lifetime instead of vanishing this frame.
	function Particle:SoftDisable(item)
		if not item then return end
		local CHS = IS_PLUGIN and game:GetService("RunService"):IsEdit() and game:GetService("ChangeHistoryService") or nil
		if CHS then CHS:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Soft Disable") end
		haltEmission(self, item, false)
		if CHS then CHS:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Soft Disable") end
	end

	-- Recursive disable. Walks `item` + descendants, soft-stopping each:
	--   - Transformed item → :SoftDisable (stop new emission, live particles finish Lifetime).
	--   - Raw PE / Trail / Beam → .Enabled=false (native soft stop).
	--   - Container → walks descendants once, recurses children with `_parentCovered` flag.
	-- For an instant scene-clear that reclaims live clones, call :Disable per item instead.
	function Particle:AbsoluteDisable(item, _parentCovered)
		if not item then return end
		if item:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
			self:SoftDisable(item)
			return
		end
		if item:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or item:IsA("Trail") or item:IsA("Beam") then
			if _parentCovered then return end
			pcall(function() item.Enabled = false end)
			return
		end
		local shouldCover = (item:IsA("BasePart") or item:IsA("Attachment") or item:IsA("Model")) and not _parentCovered
		if shouldCover then
			for _, desc in ipairs(item:GetDescendants()) do
				if (desc:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or desc:IsA("Trail") or desc:IsA("Beam"))
					and not desc:GetAttribute("Transformed")
					and not _hasTransformedAncestor(desc, item) then
					pcall(function() desc.Enabled = false end)
				end
			end
		end
		local covered = shouldCover or _parentCovered
		for _, child in item:GetChildren() do
			if item:IsA("BasePart") and child:IsA("BasePart") and not child:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
				continue
			end
			self:AbsoluteDisable(child, covered)
		end
	end

	-- Start one Animate cycle. 3D = animate source in-place; Screen/ImageLabel = singleton clone.
	function Particle:EmitAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
		self:_warnIfNotActivated("EmitAnimate")
		local isCloneAnimate = item:IsA("BlurEffect")
			or item:IsA("BloomEffect")
			or item:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect")
			or item:IsA("Atmosphere")
			or item:IsA("ImageLabel")
		if isCloneAnimate and self.ActiveAnimates[item] then return end
		cancelAnimation(self, item)
		if item:IsA("Beam") then self:EmitBeamAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
		elseif item:IsA("Trail") and item:FindFirstChild("PartIcleProperties") then self:EmitTrailAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
		elseif item:IsA("Highlight") then self:EmitHighlightAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
		elseif item:IsA("Attachment") then self:EmitAttachmentAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
		elseif item:IsA("Model") then self:EmitModelAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
		elseif item:IsA("BlurEffect") then self:EmitBlurAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
		elseif item:IsA("BloomEffect") then self:EmitBloomAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
		elseif item:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") then self:EmitColorCorrectionAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
		elseif item:IsA("Atmosphere") then self:EmitAtmosphereAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
		elseif item:IsA("ImageLabel") then self:EmitImageLabelAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
		elseif item:IsA("BasePart") then self:EmitPartAnimate(item, link, emitCtx) end
	end

	-- Emit honoring EmitCount + EmitDelay + EmitDuration. Animate mode: EmitDuration bounds AnimateLoop.
	function Particle:EnableEmit(item, link, emitCtx)
		self:_warnIfNotActivated("EnableEmit")
		local emissionMode = item:GetAttribute('EmissionMode') or "Emit"
		-- Zero-as-zero: missing EmitCount → default 1; explicit 0 → no emission.
		local rawEmitCount = item:GetAttribute('EmitCount')
		local emitCount = rawEmitCount == nil and 1 or rawEmitCount
		local emitDelay = item:GetAttribute('EmitDelay') or 0
		-- EmitDuration: number or "min,max" range string.
		local emitDuration = ParticlesMod.parseDuration(item:GetAttribute('EmitDuration')) or 0
		-- Animate items with default 0/0 still reach EmitAnimate (AnimateLoop drives them).
		if emissionMode ~= "Animate" and emitCount <= 0 and emitDuration <= 0 then return end

		-- Skip _emitGen serialization for: chain-driven (N parallel chains), nested-driven
		-- (one chain per parent particle  -  multiple parents must coexist), and instant
		-- bursts. Nested-driven detected via emitCtx._parentAlive set by NestedEmit.walk.
		local isChainDriven = emitCtx and emitCtx.ChainCtx ~= nil
		local isNestedDriven = emitCtx and emitCtx._parentAlive ~= nil
		local skipGenSerialization = isChainDriven or isNestedDriven or emitDuration <= 0
		local startGen
		if not skipGenSerialization then
			startGen = (item:GetAttribute("_emitGen") or 0) + 1
			pcall(function() item:SetAttribute("_emitGen", startGen) end)
		end
		-- Engine-session gen invalidates closures past Activate/Deactivate.
		local engineGen = self._engineGen or 0
		local function genStillCurrent()
			if self.Connection == nil then return false end
			if (self._engineGen or 0) ~= engineGen then return false end
			if not item.Parent then return false end
			if not skipGenSerialization and (item:GetAttribute("_emitGen") or 0) ~= startGen then
				return false
			end
			-- Nested-emit cancellation: parent's Engine cleanup flips _parentAlive[1].
			if emitCtx and emitCtx._parentAlive and not emitCtx._parentAlive[1] then return false end
			return true
		end

		if emissionMode == "Animate" then
			local function doAnimate()
				if not genStillCurrent() then return end
				if emitDuration > 0 then
					item:SetAttribute("AnimateLoop", true)
					task.delay(emitDuration, function()
						if not genStillCurrent() then return end
						if item:GetAttribute("AnimateLoop") then item:SetAttribute("AnimateLoop", false) end
					end)
				end
				self:EmitAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
			end
			if emitDelay > 0 then task.delay(emitDelay, doAnimate) else doAnimate() end
			return
		end

		local config = TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)

		local function doEmit()
			if not genStillCurrent() then return end
			-- emitCtx threads EmitIndex/EmitCount for OnEmit payloads + EvenDistribution.
			for i = 1, emitCount do
				self:Emit(item, link, Events.withEmitIndexAndCount(emitCtx, i, emitCount))
			end
			if emitDuration > 0 then
				if isChainDriven or isNestedDriven then
					-- Chain-driven OR nested-driven: independent parallel loop. Don't flip
					-- cfg.Enabled  -  nested-driven must not touch the user's standalone
					-- Enabled state on the nested item, since each parent particle has its
					-- own _parentAlive lifetime; cfg.Enabled is reserved for user intent.
					self:Enable(item, link, emitDuration, emitCtx)
				else
					-- User-driven duration emit: flip cfg.Enabled so the engine listener
					-- treats this as the canonical Enable cycle, schedule shared cleanup.
					-- Claim the item so a separate Part module instance skips its auto-Enable.
					item:SetAttribute("_PartIclePlaying", true)
					if config then config:SetAttribute("Enabled", true) end
					self:Enable(item, link, emitDuration, emitCtx)
					task.delay(emitDuration, function()
						if not genStillCurrent() then return end
						if config and config.Parent then config:SetAttribute("Enabled", false) end
						item:SetAttribute("_PartIclePlaying", nil)
					end)
				end
			end
		end

		if emitDelay > 0 then task.delay(emitDelay, doEmit) else doEmit() end
	end

	-- Continuous emit loop until duration / cfg.Enabled / parent / engine-gen drift.
	-- Animate mode short-circuits to AnimateLoop=true + EmitAnimate.
	function Particle:Enable(item, link, duration, emitCtx)
		self:_warnIfNotActivated("Enable")
		local data = self:GetData(item)
		if not data then return end
		local emissionMode = item:GetAttribute('EmissionMode') or "Emit"
		if emissionMode == "Animate" then
			item:SetAttribute("AnimateLoop", true)
			self:EmitAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
			return
		end
		local loopDuration = duration or math.huge
		local config = TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
		-- Chain-driven AND nested-driven loops run parallel (own bucket); user-driven
		-- cancel-and-replace. Nested-driven means each parent particle gets its OWN
		-- independent task whose lifetime tracks _parentAlive[1].
		local isChainDriven = emitCtx and emitCtx.ChainCtx ~= nil
		local isNestedDriven = emitCtx and emitCtx._parentAlive ~= nil
		local isParallel = isChainDriven or isNestedDriven
		local engineGenAtStart = self._engineGen or 0
		local function loopBody()
			local startTime = os.clock()
			local emitAccum = 0 -- sub-frame Rate carry
			-- Per-property EvenDistribution cycle state (loop-local → fresh per :Enable
			-- → automatic reset on cfg.Enabled toggle / re-enable). Direction follows
			-- sign of signedN: positive = forward (1..|N|), negative = reverse (|N|..1).
			local posIdx, posSignedN = 0, 0
			local rotIdx, rotSignedN = 0, 0
			while true do
				if isParallel and (self._engineGen or 0) ~= engineGenAtStart then break end
				-- Nested-driven: bail when this parent particle dies. Sibling parents'
				-- loops are independent (different _parentAlive table per parent emit).
				if isNestedDriven and emitCtx._parentAlive and not emitCtx._parentAlive[1] then break end
				if not item or not item.Parent then
					if not isParallel then Particle.ActiveLoops[item] = nil end; break
				end
				if os.clock() - startTime >= loopDuration then
					if not isParallel then Particle.ActiveLoops[item] = nil end; break
				end
				if not isParallel and not data.CheckEnabled() then
					Particle.ActiveLoops[item] = nil; break
				end
				local dt = LOOP_YIELD_EVENT:Wait()
				-- Studio-unfocused pause; runtime always passes (Selection:Get is editor-only).
				if IS_STUDIO and IS_PLUGIN and not Particle._focused then
					local sel = Selection:Get()
					if #sel == 0 or (Particle._unfocusedAt > 0 and os.clock() - Particle._unfocusedAt > 600) then emitAccum = 0; continue end
				end
				local currentRate = config and config:GetAttribute("Rate") or 10
				if currentRate <= 0 then emitAccum = 0; continue end
				local interval = 1 / currentRate
				emitAccum = emitAccum + dt
				local hasPosEven = (data.PosXEven or data.PosYEven or data.PosZEven) == true
				local hasRotEven = (data.RotXEven or data.RotYEven or data.RotZEven) == true
				while emitAccum >= interval do
					emitAccum = emitAccum - interval
					if hasPosEven or hasRotEven then
						local posAbs, rotAbs = 0, 0
						if hasPosEven then
							posIdx, posSignedN, posAbs = EvenCycle.step(posIdx, posSignedN, config, "PositionEvenCycle", currentRate)
						end
						if hasRotEven then
							rotIdx, rotSignedN, rotAbs = EvenCycle.step(rotIdx, rotSignedN, config, "RotationEvenCycle", currentRate)
						end
						self:Emit(item, link, Events.withEvenCtx(emitCtx, posIdx, posAbs, rotIdx, rotAbs))
					else
						self:Emit(item, link, emitCtx)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		if isParallel then
			-- Bucket per-item so Disable can cancel; task self-removes its entry on
			-- completion. Nested-driven and chain-driven share this bucket: both are
			-- independent parallel tasks that must coexist (one per parent particle
			-- for nested-driven; one per chain stagger for chain-driven).
			local chainTask = task.spawn(function()
				loopBody()
				local selfThread = coroutine.running()
				local bucket = Particle.ActiveChainLoops[item]
				if not bucket then return end
				for i = #bucket, 1, -1 do
					if bucket[i] == selfThread then table.remove(bucket, i); break end
				end
				if #bucket == 0 then Particle.ActiveChainLoops[item] = nil end
			end)
			local bucket = Particle.ActiveChainLoops[item]
			if not bucket then bucket = {}; Particle.ActiveChainLoops[item] = bucket end
			table.insert(bucket, chainTask)
		else
			if Particle.ActiveLoops[item] then task.cancel(Particle.ActiveLoops[item]) end
			Particle.ActiveLoops[item] = task.spawn(loopBody)
		end
	end

	-- Origin override supported on Part/Attachment/Model only; reject + warn-once for others.
	local enableEmitAtUnsupported = {}
	local enableEmitAtAnimateWarned = false
	function Particle:EnableEmitAt(item, originCF, options)
		if not item or not item.Parent or not originCF then return end
		if not (item:IsA("BasePart") or item:IsA("Attachment") or item:IsA("Model")) then
			local key = item.ClassName
			if not enableEmitAtUnsupported[key] then
				enableEmitAtUnsupported[key] = true
				warn(("[Part-Icles] EnableEmitAt does not support %s targets (origin " ..
					"override is BasePart/Attachment/Model only). Emit skipped."):format(key))
			end
			return
		end
		-- Animate uses LIVE source RT; origin override would mutate authored position. Reject.
		if (item:GetAttribute("EmissionMode") or "Emit") == "Animate" then
			if not enableEmitAtAnimateWarned then
				enableEmitAtAnimateWarned = true
				warn("[Part-Icles] EnableEmitAt does not support Animate-mode targets " ..
					"in v1; use EmitMode=AtTarget for Animate sources. Emit skipped.")
			end
			return
		end
		options = options or {}
		-- Link / EmitParent persist via SetLink / SetEmitParent. Both no-op on non-Transformed
		-- items (SetLink early-return); raw BasePart / Attachment / Model targets simply skip.
		if options.Link ~= nil then
			self:SetLink(item, options.Link, options.LinkMode or "Weld")
		end
		if options.EmitParent ~= nil then
			self:SetEmitParent(item, options.EmitParent)
		end
		local emitCtx = {
			ChainCtx            = options.ChainCtx,
			EventOriginCF       = originCF,
			EventOriginResolver = options.OriginResolver,
			UseFullOrigin       = options.UseFullOrigin ~= false,
			IgnoreLink          = options.IgnoreLink == true,
		}
		self:EnableEmit(item, nil, emitCtx)
	end

	-- Register fresh pData: stamp chain id, insert ActiveEmits, seed OnHit raycast, fire OnEmit.
	function Particle:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)
		-- Active-particle cap (counts ActiveEmits + linger visuals).
		local cap = self.MAX_ACTIVE_PARTICLES or 1000
		if #self.ActiveEmits + (self._lingerVisualCount or 0) >= cap then
			-- 3D Animate uses LIVE source RT; can't destroy. Clone-Animate (Screen/ImageLabel) destroys.
			local liveRTAnimate = pData.IsAnimate and (pData.Type == "Part" or pData.Type == "Attachment"
				or pData.Type == "Beam" or pData.Type == "Model")
			if pData.IsAnimate and pData._sourceItem then self.ActiveAnimates[pData._sourceItem] = nil end
			if not liveRTAnimate and pData.VisualPart and pData.VisualPart.Parent then
				-- Cap-reject: route through _releaseOrDestroy so the visual enters the pool.
				-- a warm pool helps most.
				self:_releaseOrDestroy(pData, pData.VisualPart)
			end
			return
		end
		-- Root emits with no incoming emitCtx still get a fresh ChainCtx so OnEmit /
		-- OnDeath / OnHit on the same particle share identity (otherwise OnDeath would fire
		-- under a NEW root chain and chain-tracking across lifetime would break).
		pData.EventChainCtx = (emitCtx and emitCtx.ChainCtx) or pData.EventChainCtx or Events.newChainCtx()
		table.insert(self.ActiveEmits, pData)
		if pData.Events and pData.Events.OnHit then
			pData.LastHitCheckPos = Events.getWorldPosition(pData)
			pData.HitParams = Events.makeHitParams(pData)
			pData._hitFired = false
		end
		if pData.Events and pData.Events.OnEmit then
			-- Build payload explicitly so EmitIndex (per-burst index) reaches user scripts.
			-- Events.fire's nil-payload fallback can't synthesize EmitIndex because it
			-- doesn't see emitCtx.
			local payload = Events.makePayload(self, pData, "OnEmit", emitCtx)
			Events.fire(self, pData, "OnEmit", pData.EventChainCtx, payload)
		end
	end

	-- OnDeath fire helper; manual Kill suppresses unless fireOnDeath=true.
	function Particle:_fireOnDeath(pData)
		if pData.Events and pData.Events.OnDeath
			and (not pData._killedManually or pData._fireOnDeathOverride) then
			Events.fire(self, pData, "OnDeath", pData.EventChainCtx, nil)
		end
	end

	-- OnDestruction fire helper for Heartbeat destroy paths + finishAnimate.
	function Particle:_fireOnDestruction(pData, visualPart)
		if pData.Events and pData.Events.OnDestruction and visualPart and visualPart.Parent then
			Events.fire(self, pData, "OnDestruction", pData.EventChainCtx, nil)
		end
	end

	-- Release visual to pool when eligible, else Destroy. Animate visuals never pool.
	function Particle:_releaseOrDestroy(pData, visualPart)
		if not visualPart then return end
		if not visualPart.Parent then return end
		if pData.IsAnimate or not pData._sourceRT or not pData._poolKind then
			pcall(function() visualPart:Destroy() end)
			return
		end
		-- Live Rate read so pool cap tracks emitter rate.
		local rate
		local source = pData._sourceItem
		if source and source.Parent then
			local cfg = TypeRegistry.getConfig(source)
			if cfg then rate = cfg:GetAttribute("Rate") end
		end
		Pool.release(visualPart, pData._sourceRT, pData._poolKind, rate)
	end

	-- Engine-session predicate; ParticlesMod delayed closures bail on _engineGen drift.
	function Particle:_makeAliveCheck()
		local engineGen = self._engineGen or 0
		return function()
			return self.Connection ~= nil and (self._engineGen or 0) == engineGen
		end
	end

	-- AnimateLoop cycle restart: re-seed OnHit + fire OnEmit. EmitIndex nil for re-fires.
	function Particle:_fireAnimateCycleRestartEvents(pData)
		if pData.Events and pData.Events.OnHit then
			pData.LastHitCheckPos = Events.getWorldPosition(pData)
			pData.LastHitCheckTime = nil
		end
		if pData.Events and pData.Events.OnEmit then
			local payload = Events.makePayload(self, pData, "OnEmit", { ChainCtx = pData.EventChainCtx, EmitIndex = nil })
			Events.fire(self, pData, "OnEmit", pData.EventChainCtx, payload)
		end
	end

	-- payload.Kill flags-only; Heartbeat death branch destroys + restores. PartLife=0 forces immediate.
	-- Animate also flips AnimateLoop=false + cfg.Enabled=false so death branch goes to animate-finish.
	function Particle:_killParticle(pData, opts)
		opts = opts or {}
		pData._killedManually = true
		pData._fireOnDeathOverride = opts.fireOnDeath == true
		pData._forceDead = true
		pData.PartLife = 0
		if pData.IsAnimate then
			local source = pData._sourceItem
			if source then
				pcall(function()
					source:SetAttribute("AnimateLoop", false)
					-- Enabled is on Configuration, not item; route through config.
					local cfg = TypeRegistry.getConfig(source)
					if cfg then cfg:SetAttribute("Enabled", false) end
				end)
			end
		end
	end
end

children.name: LinkService
children.source:
--[[
	LinkService  -  standalone CFrame-tracking service.
	Users link arbitrary BaseParts / Models / Attachments to any target Instance
	(BasePart / Model / Attachment / Bone / Camera) using the same LinkMode dispatch
	as the particle runtime, without spawning particles.

	API:
	  LinkService:Activate()
	  LinkService:Deactivate()
	  LinkService:Link(part1, target, mode, duration)
	  LinkService:Clear(part1)
	  LinkService:IsLinked(part1) -> boolean

	mode: "Weld" | "Follow" | "Pivot" | "WeldWithoutRotation" (unknown -> "Weld")
	duration: optional number of seconds; nil = infinite. Entry auto-clears on expiry,
	          target destruction, or part1 destruction.

	Anchored is snapshotted at :Link time and forced true so Roblox physics does not
	fight per-frame CFrame writes; restored on :Clear / auto-expire.
]]

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)

-- Resume in PreRender on client (after physics + attachment-transform propagation
-- complete; matches the Lifecycle.luau LOOP_YIELD_EVENT choice). Heartbeat on server
-- since PreRender is client-only.
local TICK_EVENT = RunService:IsClient() and RunService.PreRender or RunService.Heartbeat

local LinkService = {}

LinkService._active = false
LinkService._connection = nil
LinkService._links = {}
LinkService._anchorSnapshot = {}
LinkService._warnedNotActive = false

local VALID_MODES = {
	Weld = true,
	Follow = true,
	Pivot = true,
	WeldWithoutRotation = true,
}

local function _readPart1CF(part1)
	if part1:IsA("Model") then
		local ok, cf = pcall(part1.GetPivot, part1)
		if ok and cf then return cf end
		return CFrame.new()
	end
	if part1:IsA("Attachment") then return part1.WorldCFrame end
	return part1.CFrame
end

local function _classifyPart1(part1)
	if part1:IsA("Model") then return "Model" end
	if part1:IsA("Attachment") then return "Attachment" end
	return "Part"
end

-- Snapshot prior Anchored state + force true. Attachment has no Anchored  -  returns nil.
-- BasePart returns a bool. Model returns a table {[BasePart] = priorAnchored} so non-
-- PrimaryPart members do not free-fall under gravity while PivotTo drives PrimaryPart.
function LinkService:_captureAndAnchor(part1)
	if part1:IsA("BasePart") then
		local prior = part1.Anchored
		part1.Anchored = true
		return prior
	end
	if part1:IsA("Model") then
		local snapshot = {}
		for _, desc in ipairs(part1:GetDescendants()) do
			if desc:IsA("BasePart") then
				snapshot[desc] = desc.Anchored
				desc.Anchored = true
			end
		end
		return snapshot
	end
	return nil
end

function LinkService:_restoreAnchor(part1)
	local prior = self._anchorSnapshot[part1]
	self._anchorSnapshot[part1] = nil
	if prior == nil then return end
	if part1:IsA("BasePart") and part1.Parent then
		part1.Anchored = prior
		return
	end
	if part1:IsA("Model") and type(prior) == "table" then
		for desc, priorAnchored in pairs(prior) do
			if desc.Parent then desc.Anchored = priorAnchored end
		end
	end
end

-- Start the per-frame link-tracking loop. Idempotent.
function LinkService:Activate()
	if self._active then return end
	self._active = true
	self._connection = TICK_EVENT:Connect(function(dt)
		self:_tick(dt)
	end)
end

-- Stop tracking + clear every active link, restoring each part1's prior Anchored state.
function LinkService:Deactivate()
	if not self._active then return end
	self._active = false
	if self._connection then
		self._connection:Disconnect()
		self._connection = nil
	end
	for part1 in pairs(self._links) do
		self._links[part1] = nil
		self:_restoreAnchor(part1)
	end
end

-- Pin `part1`'s CFrame to follow `target` every frame using `mode` (Weld / Follow /
-- Pivot / WeldWithoutRotation). `duration` (optional seconds) auto-clears the link
-- when elapsed; nil = persist until Clear. Anchored is snapshotted+forced true so
-- physics does not fight the per-frame CFrame writes; restored on Clear.
function LinkService:Link(part1, target, mode, duration)
	if not part1 or not target then return end
	if part1 == target then return end
	if not (part1:IsA("BasePart") or part1:IsA("Model") or part1:IsA("Attachment")) then return end
	if not part1.Parent or not target.Parent then return end
	if not VALID_MODES[mode] then mode = "Weld" end
	if not self._active and not self._warnedNotActive then
		self._warnedNotActive = true
		warn("[Part-Icles LinkService] Link called before Activate(); the link won't update until you call LinkService:Activate(). This warning fires once.")
	end

	local targetCF = Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(target)
	local part1CF = _readPart1CF(part1)

	-- Snapshot Anchored on first Link only; re-Link of same part1 keeps the original
	-- prior-state so a Clear after multiple Links restores the truly-authored value.
	if self._anchorSnapshot[part1] == nil and not self._links[part1] then
		self._anchorSnapshot[part1] = self:_captureAndAnchor(part1)
	else
		-- Re-arm anchor flag in case user toggled it between Link calls.
		self:_captureAndAnchor(part1)
	end

	self._links[part1] = {
		target = target,
		mode = mode,
		offsetCF = targetCF:ToObjectSpace(part1CF),
		rotation = part1CF.Rotation,
		expiresAt = duration and (os.clock() + duration) or nil,
		partKind = _classifyPart1(part1),
	}
end

-- Stop tracking `part1`; restore its prior Anchored state. No-op if not linked.
function LinkService:Clear(part1)
	if not self._links[part1] then return end
	self._links[part1] = nil
	self:_restoreAnchor(part1)
end

-- Returns true when `part1` has an active link entry.
function LinkService:IsLinked(part1)
	return self._links[part1] ~= nil
end

function LinkService:_tick(dt)
	local now = os.clock()
	for part1, entry in pairs(self._links) do
		if not part1.Parent or not entry.target.Parent then
			self:Clear(part1)
		elseif entry.expiresAt and now >= entry.expiresAt then
			self:Clear(part1)
		else
			local targetCF = Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(entry.target)
			local newCF
			if entry.mode == "Weld" then
				newCF = targetCF * entry.offsetCF
			else
				-- Follow / Pivot / WeldWithoutRotation: position tracks the linked offset,
				-- rotation stays at the authored snapshot. WWR's mesh-frame variant from
				-- the particle pipeline doesn't apply outside emit; v1 treats it as Follow.
				newCF = CFrame.new((targetCF * entry.offsetCF).Position) * entry.rotation
			end
			if entry.partKind == "Model" then
				pcall(function() part1:PivotTo(newCF) end)
			elseif entry.partKind == "Attachment" then
				local parent = part1.Parent
				if parent and parent:IsA("BasePart") then
					part1.CFrame = parent.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(newCF)
				end
			else
				part1.CFrame = newCF
			end
		end
	end
end

return LinkService

children.name: LinkTrack
children.source:
--[[
	LinkTrack Mixin  -  per-frame link transform reapply for Part / Model / Attachment.
	Runs every Heartbeat (outside the step gate) so linked particles track their link every frame.
	`pData._localWorldCF` is the link-relative composed CFrame stashed by UpdatePart/Model/Attachment.
	Attachment composes in actualParent-local space, mirroring getAttachmentLinkCF in Update.luau.
]]

local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)

return function(Particle)

-- Per-frame link-CFrame writer. Composes `pData._localWorldCF` against the live link
-- target and writes the result to `pData.VisualPart` so linked particles track their
-- link every Heartbeat. No-op when pData.Link is nil or destroyed.
function Particle:ReapplyLink(pData)
	local link = pData.Link
	if not link then return end
	-- Detect mid-flight link destruction: drop pData.Link so the next frame
	-- falls back to free-flying physics instead of freezing on the link's
	-- last CFrame (and avoiding a Model:GetPivot throw on a destroyed model
	-- with no PrimaryPart).
	if not link.Parent then
		pData.Link = nil
		return
	end
	local lcf = pData._localWorldCF
	if not lcf then return end
	if not pData.VisualPart or not pData.VisualPart.Parent then return end
	local t = pData.Type
	if t ~= "Part" and t ~= "Model" and t ~= "Attachment" then return end

	if t == "Attachment" then
		local visualParent = pData.VisualPart.Parent
		if not visualParent then return end
		-- RigidLocal: per-frame parent CFrame stays frozen at the emit-time snapshot
		-- (world space). Live link motion is intentionally ignored.
		local linkWorldCF = (pData.LinkMode == "RigidLocal")
			and (pData._rigidLocalParentCF or CFrame.new())
			or Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(link)
		local convCF = visualParent:IsA("BasePart") and visualParent.CFrame or CFrame.new()
		local linkLocalCF = convCF:ToObjectSpace(linkWorldCF)
		local parentCF_now
		if pData.LinkMode == "Follow" or pData.LinkMode == "Pivot" then
			parentCF_now = CFrame.new(linkLocalCF.Position)
		else
			parentCF_now = linkLocalCF
		end
		pData.VisualPart.CFrame = parentCF_now * lcf
		return
	end

	-- RigidLocal: read the at-emit snapshot, not the live link. lcf composes against
	-- the frozen frame so the particle behaves like Weld-then-released.
	local linkCF = (pData.LinkMode == "RigidLocal")
		and (pData._rigidLocalParentCF or CFrame.new())
		or Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(link)
	local linkPos = linkCF.Position

	local lm = pData.LinkMode
	local newCF
	if lm == "WeldWithoutRotation" then
		-- Offset rotates with link, mesh rotation stays independent.
		local worldOffset = linkCF:VectorToWorldSpace(lcf.Position)
		local rotOnly = lcf - lcf.Position
		newCF = CFrame.new(linkPos + worldOffset) * rotOnly
	elseif lm == "Follow" or lm == "Pivot" then
		newCF = CFrame.new(linkPos) * lcf
	else -- Weld
		newCF = linkCF * lcf
	end

	if t == "Model" then
		pData.VisualPart:PivotTo(newCF)
	else
		pData.VisualPart.CFrame = newCF
	end
end

end

children.name: NestedEmit
children.source:
--[[
	NestedEmit - source-walk dispatcher for nested transformed Part-Icles.

	Walks SOURCE RenderTemplate (never clones nested-source subtrees). Each
	transformed leaf fires via particle:EnableEmit with link=clonedRoot, which
	EmitPart's link branch consumes for both initial spawn pose and per-frame
	tracking. parentAlive cancels nested closures on parent pData reclaim.
]]

local Pool = require(script.Parent.Pool)

local NestedEmit = {}

-- Walk source RT, fire each Transformed leaf. onNode(srcNode) optional pre-emit
-- hook (EmitModel uses for _parentScaleMap registration). _parentCloneMap forwards
-- Pool's source-to-clone map so nested Trail/Beam can rebind Attachment0/1.
function NestedEmit.walk(particle, sourceRT, clonedRoot, parentAlive, emitCtx, onNode)
	local parentCloneMap = Pool._cloneMaps and Pool._cloneMaps[clonedRoot]
	local function visit(node)
		if node:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
			if onNode then onNode(node) end
			local descCtx = {}
			if emitCtx then
				descCtx.ChainCtx  = emitCtx.ChainCtx
				descCtx.EmitIndex = emitCtx.EmitIndex
				descCtx.EmitCount = emitCtx.EmitCount
			end
			descCtx._parentAlive = parentAlive
			descCtx._parentCloneMap = parentCloneMap
			particle:EnableEmit(node, clonedRoot, descCtx)
			return
		end
		for _, child in node:GetChildren() do visit(child) end
	end
	visit(sourceRT)
end

return NestedEmit

children.name: Orientation
children.source:
--[[
	Orientation Mixin  -  per-frame rotation overlay for Part / Model / Attachment.
	Modes mirror ParticleOrientation: None, FacingCamera, FacingCameraWorldUp,
	VelocityParallel, VelocityPerpendicular. Composes as `orient * existingRotation`.
]]

return function(Particle)

local EPS = 1e-3
local Y_AXIS = Vector3.yAxis
local X_AXIS = Vector3.xAxis
local DEFAULT_VEL = -Vector3.zAxis

function Particle:ApplyOrientation(pData, dt, camPos)
	local mode = pData.Orientation
	if not mode or mode == "None" then return end
	if not pData.VisualPart or not pData.VisualPart.Parent then return end
	local t = pData.Type
	if t ~= "Part" and t ~= "Model" and t ~= "Attachment" then return end

	local isModel = t == "Model"
	local isAttachment = t == "Attachment"
	-- Use pre-overlay base CFrame; reading live would compound previous frame's compose into existingRot.
	local currentCF = pData._postUpdateCF or (isModel and pData.VisualPart:GetPivot() or pData.VisualPart.CFrame)

	-- Attachment.CFrame is parent-local; work in world space for the lookAt, convert back on write.
	local parentPart
	if isAttachment then
		parentPart = pData.VisualPart.Parent
		if parentPart and parentPart:IsA("BasePart") then
			currentCF = parentPart.CFrame * currentCF
		else
			parentPart = nil
		end
	end

	local pos = currentCF.Position
	local existingRot = currentCF - pos

	local vel
	if pData._lastOrientPos then
		vel = (pos - pData._lastOrientPos) / math.max(dt, 1e-4)
	else
		vel = pData.BaseDirection or DEFAULT_VEL
	end
	pData._lastOrientPos = pos

	local orientRot
	if mode == "FacingCamera" then
		if not camPos then return end
		local toCam = camPos - pos
		if toCam.Magnitude < EPS then return end
		orientRot = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, toCam.Unit)
	elseif mode == "FacingCameraWorldUp" then
		-- Yaw-only: flatten camera direction onto XZ so mesh rotates around world Y only.
		if not camPos then return end
		local toCam = camPos - pos
		local flat = Vector3.new(toCam.X, 0, toCam.Z)
		if flat.Magnitude < EPS then return end
		orientRot = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, flat.Unit, Y_AXIS)
	elseif mode == "VelocityParallel" then
		-- DirMode=Local already aligns via LocalCF; overlaying here would double-rotate.
		if pData.VelocityVectored then return end
		-- forward = velocity, roll tracks camera so broadside stays visible.
		if vel.Magnitude < EPS then return end
		local upHint = camPos and (camPos - pos) or Y_AXIS
		if upHint.Magnitude < EPS then upHint = Y_AXIS end
		orientRot = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, vel.Unit, upHint.Unit)
	elseif mode == "VelocityPerpendicular" then
		-- up = velocity, forward fixed in world-horizontal plane.
		if vel.Magnitude < EPS then return end
		local upV = vel.Unit
		local fwd = upV:Cross(Y_AXIS)
		if fwd.Magnitude < EPS then fwd = upV:Cross(X_AXIS) end
		orientRot = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, fwd.Unit, upV)
	else
		-- Warn once per pData on unknown Orientation so typos don't fail silently.
		if not pData._orientWarned then
			pData._orientWarned = true
			warn("Part-Icles: unknown Orientation '" .. tostring(pData.Orientation) .. "' on emitted particle  -  falling back to identity.")
		end
		return
	end

	local newCF = CFrame.new(pos) * orientRot * existingRot

	if parentPart then
		newCF = parentPart.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(newCF)
	end

	if isModel then
		pData.VisualPart:PivotTo(newCF)
	else
		pData.VisualPart.CFrame = newCF
	end
end

end

children.name: PartConstants
children.source:
--[[
	PartConstants  -  lookup tables and helpers shared by Emit / Update / Transform.
	  DirectionVectors[NormalId] → (axis, multiplier) for CFrame component reads.
	  shapeFunctions[ParticleEmitterShape] → (offset, rotation, direction) per shape.
	  resolveLinkCFrame, composeRotation, applyPositionOffset  -  see per-function comments.
]]

local PartConstants = {}

-- Type-dispatched world CFrame: Attachment→WorldCFrame, Model→GetPivot, Bone→TransformedWorldCFrame, else .CFrame.
function PartConstants.resolveLinkCFrame(link)
	if link:IsA("Attachment") then return link.WorldCFrame end
	if link:IsA("Model") then return link:GetPivot() end
	if link:IsA("Bone") then return link.TransformedWorldCFrame end
	return link.CFrame
end

-- LocalABC entries are intrinsic Tait-Bryan Euler (body-frame composition, left-to-right).
-- Global (default) is the legacy Y*X*Z composition around fixed world axes; preserved so
-- existing saves don't shift visually on update. When the emission axis aligns with a
-- rotation axis, intrinsic ordering can no-op that axis on the launch direction  -  Global
-- gives the typical spread-cone behaviour.
function PartConstants.composeRotation(order, rotXdeg, rotYdeg, rotZdeg)
	local rxCF = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(rotXdeg), 0, 0)
	local ryCF = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(rotYdeg), 0)
	local rzCF = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(rotZdeg))
	if order == "LocalXYZ" then return rxCF * ryCF * rzCF end
	if order == "LocalXZY" then return rxCF * rzCF * ryCF end
	if order == "LocalYXZ" then return ryCF * rxCF * rzCF end
	if order == "LocalYZX" then return ryCF * rzCF * rxCF end
	if order == "LocalZXY" then return rzCF * rxCF * ryCF end
	if order == "LocalZYX" then return rzCF * ryCF * rxCF end
	return ryCF * rxCF * rzCF -- Global default
end

PartConstants.DirectionVectors = {
	[Enum.NormalId.Top]    = {vector = "UpVector",    multiplier = 1},
	[Enum.NormalId.Bottom] = {vector = "UpVector",    multiplier = -1},
	[Enum.NormalId.Front]  = {vector = "LookVector",  multiplier = 1},
	[Enum.NormalId.Back]   = {vector = "LookVector",  multiplier = -1},
	[Enum.NormalId.Left]   = {vector = "RightVector", multiplier = -1},
	[Enum.NormalId.Right]  = {vector = "RightVector", multiplier = 1},
}

-- Each shape returns (offset, lookAtRotation, outwardDirection).
-- rotation applied only when LookAtInitially is true; direction sign-modulated by ShapeInOut.
PartConstants.shapeFunctions = {
	[Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box] = function(p, emitter)
		local Px = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * p.Size.X / 2
		local Py = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * p.Size.Y / 2
		local Pz = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * p.Size.Z / 2
		-- Box has no radial; use offset.Unit (origin-aligned falls back to world up).
		local offset = Vector3.new(Px, Py, Pz)
		local dir = offset.Magnitude > 1e-4 and offset.Unit or Vector3.yAxis
		local sRot = offset.Magnitude > 1e-4 and CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(), -dir) or CFrame.new()
		return offset, sRot, dir
	end,
	[Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Sphere] = function(p, emitter)
		local outerRadius = p.Size.X / 2
		local innerRadius = outerRadius * emitter.ShapePartial
		local randomRadius = (math.random() * (outerRadius^3 - innerRadius^3) + innerRadius^3)^(1/3)
		local theta = math.random() * 2 * math.pi
		local phi = math.acos((math.random() * 2) - 1)
		local direction = Vector3.new(
			math.sin(phi) * math.cos(theta),
			math.sin(phi) * math.sin(theta),
			math.cos(phi)
		)
		return direction * randomRadius, CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(), -direction), direction
	end,
	[Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Cylinder] = function(p, emitter)
		local radius = p.Size.X / 2
		local height = p.Size.Y
		-- Area-uniform annulus radius: F^-1(u) = sqrt(u*(1-h^2) + h^2).
		local h = math.clamp(emitter.ShapePartial, 0, 1)
		local randomRadius = math.sqrt(math.random() * (1 - h * h) + h * h)
		local angle = math.random() * 2 * math.pi
		local x = randomRadius * radius * math.cos(angle)
		local y = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * (height / 2)
		local z = randomRadius * radius * math.sin(angle)
		local localOffset = Vector3.new(x, y, z)
		local direction
		if math.abs(y) > (height / 2) - 0.01 then
			direction = Vector3.new(0, math.sign(y), 0)
		else
			local lateral = Vector3.new(x, 0, z)
			if lateral.Magnitude < 0.0001 then
				direction = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
			else
				direction = lateral.Unit
			end
		end
		return localOffset, CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(), -direction), direction
	end,
	[Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Disc] = function(p, emitter)
		local radius = p.Size.X / 2
		-- Area-uniform annulus; matches Cylinder.
		local h = math.clamp(emitter.ShapePartial, 0, 1)
		local randomRadiusRatio = math.sqrt(math.random() * (1 - h * h) + h * h)
		local angle = math.random() * 2 * math.pi
		local x = randomRadiusRatio * radius * math.cos(angle)
		local z = randomRadiusRatio * radius * math.sin(angle)
		local localOffset = Vector3.new(x, 0, z)
		if localOffset.Magnitude < 0.0001 then
			return localOffset, CFrame.new(), Vector3.yAxis
		end
		local direction = localOffset.Unit
		return localOffset, CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(), -direction), direction
	end,
}

-- Apply PosX/Y/Z range offset to simCF.
-- simFrameCF: WORLD CFrame of the frame the caller's simCF is in. nil = world-space
-- sim (Part/Model siblings). For Attachment Emit: walked-up BasePart's CFrame. For
-- Attachment Animate: source attachment's WorldCFrame (composes arbitrary nest depth).
function PartConstants.applyPositionOffset(simCF, data, link, item, RangeMod, AxisLinksMod, emitCtx, simFrameCF)
	-- AxisLinks-aware sampling so linked Pos followers stay correlated; emitCtx drives
	-- PosXEven/PosYEven/PosZEven even spread. Independent sampling is the fallback.
	local pxS, pyS, pzS
	if AxisLinksMod and data.AxisLinks then
		local s = AxisLinksMod.sampleRangeAxes(data, data.AxisLinks, {"PosX","PosY","PosZ"}, RangeMod, emitCtx)
		pxS, pyS, pzS = s.PosX, s.PosY, s.PosZ
	else
		pxS = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.PosX or NumberRange.new(0))
		pyS = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.PosY or NumberRange.new(0))
		pzS = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.PosZ or NumberRange.new(0))
	end
	local px, py, pz = pxS, pyS, pzS
	if px == 0 and py == 0 and pz == 0 then return simCF end
	local posMode = data.PosMode or "Local"

	if posMode == "Local" then
		return simCF * CFrame.new(px, py, pz)
	end

	local offset = Vector3.new(px, py, pz)
	local worldOffset
	if posMode == "Global" then
		worldOffset = offset
	else -- RigidLocal: rotate by source's WORLD frame; composes through full nest chain.
		local rotCF
		if link then
			rotCF = PartConstants.resolveLinkCFrame(link)
		elseif item:IsA("Attachment") then
			rotCF = item.WorldCFrame
		elseif item:IsA("Model") then
			rotCF = item:GetPivot()
		else
			rotCF = item.CFrame
		end
		worldOffset = rotCF:VectorToWorldSpace(offset)
	end

	-- Convert world offset → caller's sim frame. nil = sim is world-space.
	local applyOffset = simFrameCF and simFrameCF:VectorToObjectSpace(worldOffset) or worldOffset
	return CFrame.new(simCF.Position + applyOffset) * simCF.Rotation
end

-- Resolve a PosOffset graph sample (rawOff) into world-frame displacement based on
-- DisplacementMode. Shared across all 6 emit paths (Part/Attachment/Model × normal/animate)
-- and Update.luau's per-frame _posOffsetFrameDelta. Three modes:
--   "Global"     → no rotation (world axes)
--   "RigidLocal" → rotated by emitterRot (emitter frame at spawn, pre-RotXYZ)
--   "Local" (or unknown) → rotated by spawnRot (post-RotXYZ particle frame)
--
-- Optional mirrorX/Y/Z axes apply a post-rotation orthogonal transform  -  used by
-- OnHit Bounce to reflect the PosOffset trajectory about hit normals. Each bounce
-- reflects all three axes about hit.Normal, accumulating as a single 3-vector basis
-- (det may flip to -1 after an odd number of bounces  -  valid for displacement).
-- nil mirror axes (default at spawn) skip the matrix application.
function PartConstants.resolveDisplacement(rawOff, mode, spawnRot, emitterRot, mirrorX, mirrorY, mirrorZ)
	local frameOff
	if mode == "Global" then
		frameOff = rawOff
	elseif mode == "RigidLocal" then
		frameOff = emitterRot:VectorToWorldSpace(rawOff)
	else
		frameOff = spawnRot:VectorToWorldSpace(rawOff)
	end
	if mirrorX then
		return mirrorX * frameOff.X + mirrorY * frameOff.Y + mirrorZ * frameOff.Z
	end
	return frameOff
end

-- Skip Coulomb cancellation when |a · n| below this  -  body parallel to surface
-- (vertical-wall-grazing case) shouldn't have its full gravity stripped.
local FREEFALL_THRESHOLD = 10

-- Coulomb contact-constraint shaping for gravity during settle. Strips normal
-- component (surface reaction force) + applies friction force on tangent vel
-- bounded by μ·|aN|. Yields standard inclined-plane dynamics: g·sinθ − μ·g·cosθ.
function PartConstants.applyContactAccel(accel, pData, dt)
	if not (pData._settleEngaged and pData._lastHitNormal) then return accel end
	local n = pData._lastHitNormal
	if n.Magnitude < 1e-4 then return accel end
	local aN_dot = accel:Dot(n)
	-- Surface only pushes (Newton's 3rd is one-directional). Gravity pointing
	-- AWAY from surface means no contact, no constraint.
	if aN_dot >= 0 then return accel end
	-- Vertical-wall escape: body parallel to surface normal has near-zero
	-- normal component. Skip constraint so gravity drags it along the wall.
	if math.abs(aN_dot) < FREEFALL_THRESHOLD then return accel end
	local aN = aN_dot * n
	local aT = accel - aN
	local mu = (pData.Events and pData.Events.OnHit and pData.Events.OnHit.Friction) or 0.2
	local vT = Vector3.zero
	if pData._accelVel then
		local av = pData._accelVel
		vT = av - av:Dot(n) * n
	end
	local vT_mag = vT.Magnitude
	local maxFrictionAccel = mu * math.abs(aN_dot)
	if vT_mag > 1e-4 then
		-- Kinetic regime: friction opposes tangent velocity, capped at Coulomb cone.
		-- Static-lock clamp prevents friction from reversing tangent vel in one step.
		local frictionAccel = (-vT.Unit) * maxFrictionAccel
		if maxFrictionAccel * (dt or 1/60) > vT_mag then
			frictionAccel = -vT / (dt or 1/60)
		end
		return aT + frictionAccel
	end
	-- Static regime: |aT| ≤ μ·|aN| means friction holds the body still
	-- (tan(θ) ≤ μ on a slope). |aT| > μ·|aN| means slope exceeds friction cone;
	-- body starts sliding at the residual tangent accel.
	local aT_mag = aT.Magnitude
	if aT_mag <= maxFrictionAccel then return Vector3.zero end
	return aT - aT.Unit * maxFrictionAccel
end

return PartConstants

children.name: Particles
children.source:
-- Particles  -  fires native ParticleEmitters/Trails inside a transformed item using the
-- EmitCount / EmitDelay / EmitDuration attributes. Per-instance gen tokens prevent stale
-- delayed-off closures from clobbering newer emit sessions.
local Range = require(script.Parent.Range)

local Particle = {}

-- EmitDuration is a number or a "min,max" range string; parse to scalar.
local function parseDuration(raw)
	if raw == nil then return nil end
	if typeof(raw) == "number" then return raw end
	local text = tostring(raw)
	local vals = {}
	for v in text:gmatch("[^,]+") do local n = tonumber(v:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")); if n then table.insert(vals, n) end end
	if #vals == 0 then return nil end
	if #vals == 1 then return vals[1] end
	local mn, mx = math.min(vals[1], vals[2]), math.max(vals[1], vals[2])
	return Range.RandomValueFromRange(NumberRange.new(mn, mx))
end
Particle.parseDuration = parseDuration

-- Skip descendants under a nested Transformed item (sub-emitter handles those itself).
local function _hasTransformedAncestor(desc, root)
	local p = desc.Parent
	while p and p ~= root do
		if p:GetAttribute("Transformed") then return true end
		p = p.Parent
	end
	return false
end

-- alive: false when engine session ended; cancels delayed STARTS only.
local function _alive(alive)
	return (not alive) or alive()
end

-- Two gens, split responsibilities. CANCEL_GEN gates delayed starts (bumped by
-- CancelNative / Pool release / Disable). DURATION_GEN gates delayed-off closures
-- (bumped on each duration-window start) so a newer window can't be turned off
-- by an older one.
local CANCEL_GEN_ATTR = "_PartIcleNativeEmitGen"
local DURATION_GEN_ATTR = "_PartIcleNativeDurationGen"

local function _readCancelGen(v)
	return v:GetAttribute(CANCEL_GEN_ATTR) or 0
end
local function _bumpCancelGen(v)
	local gen = _readCancelGen(v) + 1
	pcall(function() v:SetAttribute(CANCEL_GEN_ATTR, gen) end)
	return gen
end
local function _cancelGenStillCurrent(v, gen)
	return v.Parent ~= nil and _readCancelGen(v) == gen
end

local function _readDurationGen(v)
	return v:GetAttribute(DURATION_GEN_ATTR) or 0
end
local function _bumpDurationGen(v)
	local gen = _readDurationGen(v) + 1
	pcall(function() v:SetAttribute(DURATION_GEN_ATTR, gen) end)
	return gen
end
local function _durationGenStillCurrent(v, gen)
	return v.Parent ~= nil and _readDurationGen(v) == gen
end

-- Enabled=true now, schedule Enabled=false in `duration`. Delayed-off owned by
-- duration gen so a later SetEnabledForDuration does not get clobbered.
Particle.SetEnabledForDuration = function(v, duration)
	local durGen = _bumpDurationGen(v)
	v.Enabled = true
	task.delay(duration, function()
		if _durationGenStillCurrent(v, durGen) then v.Enabled = false end
	end)
end

-- External API kept stable: ReadNativeGen / IsNativeGenCurrent address the
-- cancel token (delayed-start gating). Callers that want delayed-off ownership
-- use SetEnabledForDuration which handles its own duration token internally.
Particle.ReadNativeGen = _readCancelGen
Particle.IsNativeGenCurrent = _cancelGenStillCurrent

-- Bump cancel + duration gens + Enabled=false. Invalidates pending delayed
-- starts AND any pending delayed-off (which would otherwise re-toggle).
Particle.CancelNative = function(v)
	_bumpCancelGen(v)
	_bumpDurationGen(v)
	pcall(function() v.Enabled = false end)
end

-- Synchronous dispatch. cancelGen captured in caller's continuation so a Heartbeat
-- tick can't interleave between capture and the delayed-START closure's check.
Particle.EnableEmit = function(part, alive)
	for i, v in part:GetDescendants() do
		if _hasTransformedAncestor(v, part) then continue end
		if v:IsA('ParticleEmitter') then
			local count = v:GetAttribute('EmitCount') or 1
			local emitDelay = v:GetAttribute('EmitDelay') or 0
			local emitDuration = v:GetAttribute('EmitDuration') or 0
			if count <= 0 and emitDuration <= 0 then continue end
			local cancelGen = _readCancelGen(v)
			local function doEmit()
				if not _alive(alive) or not _cancelGenStillCurrent(v, cancelGen) then return end
				-- Roblox :Emit(0) falls back to 1; gate on count>0.
				if count > 0 then v:Emit(count) end
				if emitDuration > 0 then
					local durGen = _bumpDurationGen(v)
					v.Enabled = true
					-- Delayed-off uses duration gen (not alive) so cleanup survives engine death.
					task.delay(emitDuration, function()
						if _durationGenStillCurrent(v, durGen) then v.Enabled = false end
					end)
				end
			end
			if emitDelay > 0 then task.delay(emitDelay, doEmit) else doEmit() end
		end
		-- Skip TrailEmitter (Transformed)  -  the engine pipeline emits cloned visuals
		-- via TrailEmitter.EmitTrail; toggling the SOURCE Trail's Enabled here would
		-- render the unwanted source Trail at default Roblox properties (white) on
		-- top of the authored emit clones.
		if v:IsA('Trail') and not v:GetAttribute('Transformed') then
			local dur = parseDuration(v:GetAttribute('EmitDuration'))
			if dur and dur > 0 then
				local cancelGen = _readCancelGen(v)
				task.delay(v:GetAttribute('EmitDelay') or 0.001, function()
					if not _alive(alive) or not _cancelGenStillCurrent(v, cancelGen) then return end
					local durGen = _bumpDurationGen(v)
					v.Enabled = true
					task.delay(dur, function()
						if _durationGenStillCurrent(v, durGen) then v.Enabled = false end
					end)
				end)
			end
		end
		-- Raw Beam: native streak between authored attachments. Skip BeamNative
		-- (Transformed)  -  directAccess type handled by Particle:EnableEmit mixin.
		-- Same gen-token pattern as Trail: cancelGen gates delayed-on, durGen owns delayed-off.
		if v:IsA('Beam') and not v:GetAttribute('Transformed') then
			local emitDuration = tonumber(v:GetAttribute('EmitDuration')) or 0
			local emitDelay = tonumber(v:GetAttribute('EmitDelay')) or 0
			if emitDuration > 0 then
				local cancelGen = _readCancelGen(v)
				local function doEmit()
					if not _alive(alive) or not _cancelGenStillCurrent(v, cancelGen) then return end
					local durGen = _bumpDurationGen(v)
					v.Enabled = true
					task.delay(emitDuration, function()
						if _durationGenStillCurrent(v, durGen) then v.Enabled = false end
					end)
				end
				if emitDelay > 0 then task.delay(emitDelay, doEmit) else doEmit() end
			end
		end
	end
end

Particle.EnableEmitSingle = function(v: Instance, alive)
	if v:IsA('Trail') then
		local dur = parseDuration(v:GetAttribute('EmitDuration'))
		if dur and dur > 0 then
			local cancelGen = _readCancelGen(v)
			local emitDelay = v:GetAttribute('EmitDelay') or 0
			local function doEnable()
				if not _alive(alive) or not _cancelGenStillCurrent(v, cancelGen) then return end
				local durGen = _bumpDurationGen(v)
				v.Enabled = true
				task.delay(dur, function()
					if _durationGenStillCurrent(v, durGen) then v.Enabled = false end
				end)
			end
			-- Synchronous enable when EmitDelay=0 so trail renders on the SAME
			-- frame as particle spawn. Prior `task.delay(EmitDelay or 0.001, ...)`
			-- forced a 1ms tick gap even with zero delay → trail invisible on
			-- frame 0, visible from frame 1+. For short-lived particles this is
			-- a noticeable gap in the trail head.
			if emitDelay > 0 then task.delay(emitDelay, doEnable) else doEnable() end
		end
	end
	if v:IsA('ParticleEmitter') then
		local count = v:GetAttribute('EmitCount') or 1
		local emitDelay = v:GetAttribute('EmitDelay') or 0
		local emitDuration = v:GetAttribute('EmitDuration') or 0
		if count <= 0 and emitDuration <= 0 then return end
		local cancelGen = _readCancelGen(v)
		local function doEmit()
			if not _alive(alive) or not _cancelGenStillCurrent(v, cancelGen) then return end
			if count > 0 then v:Emit(count) end
			if emitDuration > 0 then
				local durGen = _bumpDurationGen(v)
				v.Enabled = true
				task.delay(emitDuration, function()
					if _durationGenStillCurrent(v, durGen) then v.Enabled = false end
				end)
			end
		end
		if emitDelay > 0 then task.delay(emitDelay, doEmit) else doEmit() end
	end
end

Particle.EnableEmitChildrenAndRepeatForAttachments = function(part, alive)
	for i, v in part:GetChildren() do
		Particle.EnableEmitSingle(v, alive)
		if v:IsA('Attachment') then
			Particle.EnableEmitChildrenAndRepeatForAttachments(v, alive)
		end
	end
end

return Particle

children.name: PointLight
children.source:
--[[
	PointLight Mixin  -  Emit + Update for PointLight particles.
	Property-only animation (Range / Brightness / Color over life), no spatial motion.
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Range)
local Pool = require(script.Parent.Pool)

return function(Particle)

function Particle:UpdatePointLight(pData, dt, currentTime)
	-- Timescale v2 (signed reverse): see Update.luau UpdatePart. SetTimescale override wins for its window.
	local real_i = math.min(math.max((currentTime - pData.StartTime) / pData.LifeTime, 0), 1)
	local ts
	if pData._tsOverride ~= nil and currentTime < (pData._tsOverrideUntil or 0) then
		ts = pData._tsOverride
	else
		ts = pData.Graphs.Timescale and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(real_i, pData.Graphs.Timescale, pData.Seeds.Timescale) or 1
	end
	local dtTs = dt * ts
	local lifeTime = pData.LifeTime
	local priorEff = pData._effectiveElapsed or 0
	local newEff = priorEff + (pData._timeFrozen and 0 or dtTs)
	if newEff < 0 then newEff = 0 end
	if newEff > lifeTime then newEff = lifeTime end
	pData._effectiveElapsed = newEff
	local atForwardEnd = newEff >= lifeTime
	local atBackwardEnd = newEff <= 0
	local elapsedTime = newEff
	local i = elapsedTime / lifeTime

	if not pData.VisualPart or not pData.VisualPart.Parent then return true end
	if pData.TotalKeyFrames <= 0 then return true end
	local graphFinished = real_i >= 1
	local isDying = graphFinished and (atForwardEnd or atBackwardEnd)
	i = math.min(math.max(i, 0), 1)

	local targetStep = math.floor(i * pData.TotalKeyFrames)

	if targetStep ~= pData.CurrentStep then
		pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
		local steppedI = pData.CurrentStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames

		if pData.Graphs.PLRange then
			pData.VisualPart.Range = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.PLRange, pData.Seeds.PLRange)
		end
		if pData.Graphs.PLBrightness and not pData.SkipTransparency then
			pData.VisualPart.Brightness = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.PLBrightness, pData.Seeds.PLBrightness)
		end
		if pData.Graphs.PLColor and not pData.SkipColor then
			pData.VisualPart.Color = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.PLColor)
		end
	end

	return isDying
end

function Particle:EmitPointLight(light, link, emitCtx)
	if not light or not light.Parent then return end
	local data = self:GetData(light)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end

	-- PoolHide flipped Enabled=false on release; flip back here.
	local visualLight = Pool.acquireOrClone(data.RenderTemplate, "PointLight", data.Pool)
	visualLight.Archivable = false
	visualLight.Enabled = true
	if data.Shadows ~= nil then visualLight.Shadows = data.Shadows end
	local parentPart = data.EmitParent or link or light.Parent

	local safeLifeTime = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if safeLifeTime <= 0 then safeLifeTime = 0.001 end

	local seedRange = data.PLRange and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PLRange) or {}
	local seedBright = data.PLBrightness and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PLBrightness) or {}
	local seedTimescale = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PLTimescale)

	-- Apply initial values before parenting (1-frame pop prevention).
	if data.PLRange then
		visualLight.Range = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, data.PLRange, seedRange)
	end
	if data.PLBrightness then
		visualLight.Brightness = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, data.PLBrightness, seedBright)
	end
	if data.PLColor then
		visualLight.Color = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(0, data.PLColor)
	end

	visualLight.Parent = parentPart

	local pData = {
		Type = "PointLight",
		VisualPart = visualLight,
		Events = data.Events,
		StartTime = os.clock(),
		TotalKeyFrames = math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames),
		CurrentStep = 0,
		LifeTime = safeLifeTime,
		PartLife = data.PartLife or 0,

		Graphs = {
			PLRange = data.PLRange,
			PLBrightness = data.PLBrightness,
			PLColor = data.PLColor,
			Timescale = data.PLTimescale,
		},
		Seeds = {
			PLRange = seedRange,
			PLBrightness = seedBright,
			Timescale = seedTimescale,
		},
		_effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(data.PLTimescale, seedTimescale, safeLifeTime),
	}

	pData._sourceItem = light
	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, light)
	if data.Pool ~= false then pData._sourceRT, pData._poolKind = data.RenderTemplate, "PointLight" end
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)
end

end
