--[[
	HitFilterPanel  -  modal for the OnHit Filter row. Two controls:

	  1. Collision Group dropdown  -  RaycastParams.CollisionGroup string. Sourced
	     from PhysicsService:GetRegisteredCollisionGroups() with "(none)" as the
	     unset/default option.
	  2. Exclude List  -  multi-instance picker. Each row is one ObjectValue child
	     of the per-event ExcludeList Folder; RaycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances
	     ignores the listed Instance + all descendants by Roblox API semantics.

	Writes through to EVERY item in opts.items (multi-select edits apply across
	the selection). ChangeHistoryService waypoint per write. Reuses
	ConfigPanel.openInstancePicker for the Add button.

	Returns: { open(opts), close(), isOpen() }
	opts: { items = {...}, eventName = "OnHit" }
]]

local PhysicsService = game:GetService("PhysicsService")

return function(deps)
	local W = deps.W
	local T = deps.T
	local ConfigPanel = deps.ConfigPanel
	local EventsSchema = deps.EventsSchema
	local ChangeHistoryService = deps.ChangeHistoryService

	local _activePanel = nil
	-- True while an open modal session is collecting writes. closeActive emits the
	-- closing waypoint only when this is true; teardown calls (no session) skip it.
	local _sessionActive = false
	-- Fired once on closeActive when a session is open. Used by EventsConnectors
	-- to refresh the Events panel's Filter label (group + exclude count) without
	-- the user having to re-select the items.
	local _onCloseCallback = nil

	local function closeActive()
		local fireCallback = _sessionActive and _onCloseCallback
		if _sessionActive then
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: OnHit Filters")
			_sessionActive = false
		end
		_onCloseCallback = nil
		if _activePanel then
			pcall(function() _activePanel:Destroy() end)
			_activePanel = nil
		end
		if fireCallback then pcall(fireCallback) end
	end

	-- Returns array of registered group names, "(none)" prepended. PhysicsService
	-- returns {{id, name, mask}, ...}; we project to .name strings.
	local function collectGroupNames()
		local out = { "(none)" }
		local ok, groups = pcall(function() return PhysicsService:GetRegisteredCollisionGroups() end)
		if ok and type(groups) == "table" then
			for _, g in ipairs(groups) do
				if type(g) == "table" and type(g.name) == "string" then
					table.insert(out, g.name)
				end
			end
		end
		return out
	end

	-- Walk every selected item's ExcludeList folder, collect union of {.Value}
	-- references deduped. Each entry tracks how many items have that exclude so
	-- the user can see partial-selection state  -  but for simplicity we just show
	-- the union and write Add to all-without / Remove from all-with.
	local function gatherExcludes(items)
		local seen = {}
		local list = {}
		for _, item in ipairs(items) do
			local cfg = EventsSchema.readEvent(item, "OnHit")
			if cfg then
				local folder = cfg:FindFirstChild("ExcludeList")
				if folder then
					for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
						if child:IsA("ObjectValue") and child.Value and not seen[child.Value] then
							seen[child.Value] = true
							table.insert(list, child.Value)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		return list
	end

	-- These three mutators are called from inside an open modal session. Undo
	-- waypoints are batched at the open/close boundaries (see `open` below) so
	-- N edits in one session collapse to a single undo step. Per-write waypoints
	-- here would fragment the user's history.
	local function addExcludeToAll(items, inst)
		for _, item in ipairs(items) do
			local cfg = EventsSchema.readEvent(item, "OnHit")
			if cfg then
				local folder = EventsSchema.ensureExcludeListFolder(cfg)
				local alreadyHas = false
				for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
					if child:IsA("ObjectValue") and child.Value == inst then
						alreadyHas = true
						break
					end
				end
				if not alreadyHas then
					local ov = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
					ov.Name = "Exclude"
					ov.Value = inst
					ov.Parent = folder
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local function removeExcludeFromAll(items, inst)
		for _, item in ipairs(items) do
			local cfg = EventsSchema.readEvent(item, "OnHit")
			if cfg then
				local folder = cfg:FindFirstChild("ExcludeList")
				if folder then
					for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
						if child:IsA("ObjectValue") and child.Value == inst then
							child:Destroy()
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local function setGroupOnAll(items, groupName)
		-- "(none)" sentinel clears the attribute back to empty string so makeHitParams
		-- skips the CollisionGroup write entirely (matches the schema default).
		local value = (groupName == "(none)") and "" or groupName
		for _, item in ipairs(items) do
			local cfg = EventsSchema.readEvent(item, "OnHit")
			if cfg then cfg:SetAttribute("CollisionGroup", value) end
		end
	end

	-- Read group of items' CollisionGroup attr; nil = mixed, "" = none, else value.
	local function commonGroup(items)
		local first, set = nil, false
		for _, item in ipairs(items) do
			local cfg = EventsSchema.readEvent(item, "OnHit")
			local v = cfg and cfg:GetAttribute("CollisionGroup") or ""
			if not set then first = v; set = true
			elseif v ~= first then return nil end
		end
		return first
	end

	local function open(opts)
		closeActive()
		if not opts or not opts.items or #opts.items == 0 then return end

		-- Filter to items whose type actually supports OnHit. Beam / PointLight /
		-- screens / etc. return nil from readEvent and would silently no-op every
		-- write  -  surface that mismatch to the user instead of opening a dead modal.
		local originalCount = #opts.items
		local filteredItems = {}
		for _, item in ipairs(opts.items) do
			if EventsSchema.isValidForItem(item, "OnHit") then
				table.insert(filteredItems, item)
			end
		end
		if #filteredItems == 0 then
			print("[Part-Icles] OnHit filters not applicable to this selection  -  Beam / PointLight / Trail / screens do not support OnHit.")
			return
		end
		opts.items = filteredItems

		local screenGui = W.getScreenGui and W.getScreenGui() or deps.screenGui
		if not screenGui then return end

		-- Open the undo session BEFORE creating any UI. Waypoints inside the modal
		-- collapse into one undo step bracketed by this + closeActive's waypoint.
		ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before OnHit Filters")
		_sessionActive = true
		_onCloseCallback = opts.onClose  -- re-populate trigger; fired by closeActive

		local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
		panel.Name = "HitFilterPanel"
		panel.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg
		-- T.PanelAlpha matches the main settings panel so the parchment ImageLabel
		-- (attached as a sibling at ZIndex 0 via attachPanelBackground) renders
		-- through the panel's solid color instead of being fully occluded.
		panel.BackgroundTransparency = T.PanelAlpha
		panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 320, 0, 280)
		panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
		panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
		panel.ZIndex = 200
		panel.Active = true
		panel:SetAttribute("_opaquePanel", true)
		panel:SetAttribute("_noSnap", true)
		panel.Parent = screenGui
		W.addCorner(panel, T.Corner)
		W.addStroke(panel)
		W.addPadding(panel, 8, 8, 8, 8)
		W.attachPanelBackground(panel)
		_activePanel = panel

		-- Header
		local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		title.Text = "OnHit Filters"
		title.TextColor3 = T.Gold
		title.Font = T.Font
		title.TextSize = 12
		title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		title.ZIndex = 201
		title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 16)
		title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
		title.Parent = panel

		-- Drag handle covers the title bar minus the close X. ZIndex 201 keeps it
		-- above the panel's image overlay but below the close button (ZIndex 202).
		local dragHandle = Instance.new("TextButton")
		dragHandle.Name = "DragHandle"
		dragHandle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		dragHandle.Text = ""
		dragHandle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 16)
		dragHandle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
		dragHandle.ZIndex = 201
		dragHandle.Parent = panel
		W.makeDraggable(panel, dragHandle)

		local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
		closeBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		closeBtn.Text = "X"
		closeBtn.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold
		closeBtn.Font = T.Font
		closeBtn.TextSize = 12
		closeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16)
		closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 0)
		closeBtn.ZIndex = 202
		closeBtn.Parent = panel

		-- "Applies to N of M" notice when the user's selection includes items that
		-- can't take an OnHit filter. Hidden when the filter matches every item.
		if #filteredItems < originalCount then
			local notice = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			notice.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			notice.Text = ("Filters apply to %d of %d selected items"):format(#filteredItems, originalCount)
			notice.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
			notice.Font = T.Font
			notice.TextSize = 9
			notice.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
			notice.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
			notice.ZIndex = 201
			notice.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 12)
			notice.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 18)
			notice.Parent = panel
		end

		-- Collision group row
		local cgLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		cgLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		cgLbl.Text = "Collision Group"
		cgLbl.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
		cgLbl.Font = T.Font
		cgLbl.TextSize = 10
		cgLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		cgLbl.ZIndex = 201
		cgLbl.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 22)
		cgLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 22)
		cgLbl.Parent = panel

		local cgWrap = Instance.new("Frame")
		cgWrap.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		cgWrap.Size = UDim2.new(1, -104, 0, 22)
		cgWrap.Position = UDim2.new(0, 104, 0, 22)
		cgWrap.ZIndex = 201
		cgWrap.Parent = panel

		local groupNames = collectGroupNames()
		local currentGroup = commonGroup(opts.items)
		local defaultText
		if currentGroup == nil then defaultText = "~"
		elseif currentGroup == "" then defaultText = "(none)"
		else defaultText = currentGroup end
		local cgLblWidget, cgFrame, cgSetOnChanged = W.makeDropdown("CGroup", cgWrap, groupNames, defaultText)
		cgFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
		cgFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
		-- If commonGroup returned nil (mixed), show "~"; dropdown's internal value defaults
		-- to options[1] but we override the display so the user sees the mixed state.
		if currentGroup == nil then cgLblWidget.Text = "~" end
		cgSetOnChanged(function(picked)
			setGroupOnAll(opts.items, picked)
		end)

		-- Exclude List header
		local exHdr = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		exHdr.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		exHdr.Text = "Exclude List (ignores instance + descendants)"
		exHdr.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
		exHdr.Font = T.Font
		exHdr.TextSize = 10
		exHdr.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		exHdr.ZIndex = 201
		exHdr.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16)
		exHdr.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 52)
		exHdr.Parent = panel

		-- Scroll body for the list
		local scroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
		scroll.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg
		scroll.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
		scroll.BorderSizePixel = 0
		scroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 160)
		scroll.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 70)
		scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
		scroll.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		scroll.ScrollBarThickness = 6
		scroll.ZIndex = 201
		scroll.Parent = panel
		W.addCorner(scroll, UDim.new(0, 4))
		W.addPadding(scroll, 4, 4, 4, 4)
		local listLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
		listLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
		listLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 2)
		listLayout.Parent = scroll

		local function renderList()
			for _, child in ipairs(scroll:GetChildren()) do
				if not child:IsA("UIListLayout") and not child:IsA("UIPadding") then
					child:Destroy()
				end
			end
			local excludes = gatherExcludes(opts.items)
			if #excludes == 0 then
				local empty = Instance.new("TextLabel")
				empty.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				empty.Text = "(no excludes)"
				empty.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold
				empty.Font = T.Font
				empty.TextSize = 10
				empty.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
				empty.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
				empty.LayoutOrder = 0
				empty.ZIndex = 202
				empty.Parent = scroll
				return
			end
			for i, inst in ipairs(excludes) do
				local row = Instance.new("Frame")
				row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
				row.LayoutOrder = i
				row.ZIndex = 202
				row.Parent = scroll

				local pathLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
				pathLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				pathLbl.Text = inst:GetFullName()
				pathLbl.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold
				pathLbl.Font = T.Font
				pathLbl.TextSize = 10
				pathLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
				pathLbl.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
				pathLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, 0)
				pathLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
				pathLbl.ZIndex = 203
				pathLbl.Parent = row

				local rmBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
				rmBtn.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg
				rmBtn.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
				rmBtn.Text = "X"
				rmBtn.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
				rmBtn.Font = T.Font
				rmBtn.TextSize = 10
				rmBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 20, 1, 0)
				rmBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 0)
				rmBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
				rmBtn.ZIndex = 203
				rmBtn.Parent = row
				W.addCorner(rmBtn, UDim.new(0, 3))
				rmBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
					removeExcludeFromAll(opts.items, inst)
					renderList()
				end)
			end
		end
		renderList()

		-- Add button
		local addBtn = W.makeButton("AddExclude", panel, "+ Add Exclude",
			UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22), T.Gold)
		addBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -22)
		addBtn.ZIndex = 201
		addBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			if not ConfigPanel or not ConfigPanel.openInstancePicker then return end
			ConfigPanel.openInstancePicker({
				title = "Add Exclude",
				label = "Pick an Instance to exclude from OnHit",
				context = (#opts.items == 1) and opts.items[1]:GetFullName() or (#opts.items .. " items"),
				excludeItems = opts.items,
				onSet = function(picked)
					if picked then
						addExcludeToAll(opts.items, picked)
						renderList()
					end
				end,
			})
		end)

		closeBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			closeActive()
		end)
	end

	local function close()
		closeActive()
	end

	local function isOpen()
		return _activePanel ~= nil
	end

	return {
		open = open,
		close = close,
		isOpen = isOpen,
	}
end

--[[
	InventoryDissectDialog  -  Part-Icles V5
	Copyright (C) 2026 Qwinkle
	Builds the Dissect Spritesheet dialog UI.
	Returns refs table for wiring.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local W = require(script.Parent.Widgets)
local T = C.T

local DIALOG_W, DIALOG_H = 300, 240
local Z = 52

-- Alias canonical Widgets.addCorner.
local addCorner = W.addCorner

local InventoryDissectDialog = {}

function InventoryDissectDialog.build(sg)
	local refs = {}
	local _themed = W.getThemed()

	-- Backdrop
	local backdrop = Instance.new("TextButton"); backdrop.Name = "DissectBackdrop"
	backdrop.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0); backdrop.BackgroundTransparency = 0.7
	backdrop.Text = ""; backdrop.AutoButtonColor = false; backdrop.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	backdrop.ZIndex = Z - 1; backdrop.Visible = false; backdrop.Parent = sg; backdrop.BorderSizePixel = 0
	refs.DissectBackdrop = backdrop

	-- Dialog frame
	local dialog = Instance.new("Frame"); dialog.Name = "DissectDialog"
	dialog.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg; dialog.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	dialog.Size = UDim2.new(0, DIALOG_W, 0, DIALOG_H)
	dialog.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5); dialog.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
	dialog.Visible = false; dialog.ZIndex = Z; dialog.ClipsDescendants = true
	dialog:SetAttribute("_noSnap", true); dialog.Parent = sg
	-- Modal dialog should stay fully readable rather than picking up the global panel translucency.
	dialog:SetAttribute("_opaquePanel", true)
	addCorner(dialog, T.BigCorner); W.addStroke(dialog); table.insert(_themed.panels, dialog)
	W.attachPanelBackground(dialog)
	local dp = Instance.new("UIPadding"); dp.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10); dp.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10)
	dp.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 6); dp.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 8); dp.Parent = dialog
	refs.DissectDialog = dialog

	-- Header
	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel"); title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Text = "Dissect Spritesheets"; title.TextColor3 = T.Gold; title.Font = T.Font; title.TextSize = 11
	title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 18)
	title.ZIndex = Z + 1; title.Parent = dialog
	local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton"); closeBtn.Name = "Close"; closeBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	closeBtn.Text = "X"; closeBtn.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; closeBtn.Font = T.Font; closeBtn.TextSize = 11
	closeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 18); closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 0)
	closeBtn.ZIndex = Z + 2; closeBtn.Parent = dialog
	refs.DissectClose = closeBtn
	-- Drag handle
	local dragH = Instance.new("TextButton"); dragH.BackgroundTransparency = 1; dragH.Text = ""
	dragH.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 18); dragH.ZIndex = Z + 1; dragH.Parent = dialog
	W.makeDraggable(dialog, dragH)

	-- Grid row: Cols + Rows
	local gridRow = Instance.new("Frame"); gridRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	gridRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22); gridRow.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 22); gridRow.ZIndex = Z + 1; gridRow.Parent = dialog

	local colsLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel"); colsLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1; colsLbl.Text = "Cols:"
	colsLbl.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold; colsLbl.Font = T.Font; colsLbl.TextSize = 10
	colsLbl.Size = UDim2.new(0, 28, 1, 0); colsLbl.ZIndex = Z + 1; colsLbl.Parent = gridRow
	local colsBox = Instance.new("TextBox"); colsBox.Name = "ColsBox"
	colsBox.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; colsBox.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
	colsBox.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold; colsBox.Font = T.Font; colsBox.TextSize = 11; colsBox.Text = "4"
	colsBox.ClearTextOnFocus = true; colsBox.Size = UDim2.new(0, 36, 1, 0); colsBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 0)
	colsBox.BorderSizePixel = 0; colsBox.ZIndex = Z + 1; colsBox.Parent = gridRow
	addCorner(colsBox, UDim.new(0, 4)); table.insert(_themed.blobs, colsBox)

	local rowsLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel"); rowsLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1; rowsLbl.Text = "Rows:"
	rowsLbl.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold; rowsLbl.Font = T.Font; rowsLbl.TextSize = 10
	rowsLbl.Size = UDim2.new(0, 32, 1, 0); rowsLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 76, 0, 0); rowsLbl.ZIndex = Z + 1; rowsLbl.Parent = gridRow
	local rowsBox = Instance.new("TextBox"); rowsBox.Name = "RowsBox"
	rowsBox.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; rowsBox.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
	rowsBox.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold; rowsBox.Font = T.Font; rowsBox.TextSize = 11; rowsBox.Text = "4"
	rowsBox.ClearTextOnFocus = true; rowsBox.Size = UDim2.new(0, 36, 1, 0); rowsBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 110, 0, 0)
	rowsBox.BorderSizePixel = 0; rowsBox.ZIndex = Z + 1; rowsBox.Parent = gridRow
	addCorner(rowsBox, UDim.new(0, 4)); table.insert(_themed.blobs, rowsBox)
	refs.DissectCols = colsBox; refs.DissectRows = rowsBox

	-- Label
	local idsLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel"); idsLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	idsLbl.Text = "Asset IDs (one per line, or comma-separated):"; idsLbl.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold; idsLbl.Font = T.Font
	idsLbl.TextSize = 9; idsLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	idsLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 12); idsLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 48); idsLbl.ZIndex = Z + 1; idsLbl.Parent = dialog
	local fromSelBtn = Instance.new("TextButton"); fromSelBtn.Name = "FromSelection"
	fromSelBtn.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; fromSelBtn.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
	fromSelBtn.Text = "From Selection"; fromSelBtn.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold; fromSelBtn.Font = T.Font
	fromSelBtn.TextSize = 8; fromSelBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 68, 0, 14); fromSelBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -68, 0, 47)
	fromSelBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0; fromSelBtn.ZIndex = Z + 1; fromSelBtn.Parent = dialog
	addCorner(fromSelBtn, UDim.new(0, 3)); table.insert(_themed.blobs, fromSelBtn)
	refs.DissectFromSelection = fromSelBtn

	-- Multiline ID input
	local idWrap = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame"); idWrap.Name = "IDWrap"
	idWrap.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; idWrap.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
	idWrap.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 100); idWrap.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 62)
	idWrap.ScrollBarThickness = 2; idWrap.ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.ScrollBar; idWrap.BorderSizePixel = 0
	idWrap.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y; idWrap.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	idWrap.ZIndex = Z + 1; idWrap.Parent = dialog
	addCorner(idWrap, UDim.new(0, 4)); table.insert(_themed.blobs, idWrap); table.insert(_themed.scrollbars, idWrap)
	local idBox = Instance.new("TextBox"); idBox.Name = "IDBox"; idBox.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	idBox.Text = ""; idBox.PlaceholderText = "123456789\n987654321"; idBox.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold
	idBox.PlaceholderColor3 = T.DarkGold; idBox.Font = Enum.Font.Code; idBox.TextSize = 10
	idBox.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; idBox.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
	idBox.MultiLine = true; idBox.TextWrapped = true; idBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
	idBox.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 1, 0); idBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 2)
	idBox.BorderSizePixel = 0; idBox.ZIndex = Z + 2; idBox.Parent = idWrap
	-- Pin the monospace Code font: column-aligned ID lists need fixed-width glyphs,
	-- so this box opts out of the theme-font override loop (UpdateTheme in UIBuilder/init.luau)
	-- via the `_noFontOverride` attribute below.
	idBox:SetAttribute("_noFontOverride", true)
	refs.DissectIDBox = idBox

	-- Footer buttons
	local footerY = DIALOG_H - 40
	local uploadDissect = Instance.new("TextButton"); uploadDissect.Name = "UploadDissect"
	uploadDissect.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; uploadDissect.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
	uploadDissect.Text = "Upload & Dissect"; uploadDissect.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold; uploadDissect.Font = T.Font
	uploadDissect.TextSize = 9; uploadDissect.Size = UDim2.new(0.42, -2, 0, 24)
	uploadDissect.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, footerY); uploadDissect.BorderSizePixel = 0
	uploadDissect.ZIndex = Z + 1; uploadDissect.Parent = dialog
	addCorner(uploadDissect, UDim.new(0, 4)); W.addStroke(uploadDissect); table.insert(_themed.blobs, uploadDissect)
	refs.DissectUploadBtn = uploadDissect

	local dissectBtn = Instance.new("TextButton"); dissectBtn.Name = "DissectBtn"
	dissectBtn.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; dissectBtn.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
	dissectBtn.Text = "Dissect"; dissectBtn.TextColor3 = T.Green; dissectBtn.Font = T.Font
	dissectBtn.TextSize = 10; dissectBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.58, -2, 0, 24)
	dissectBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.42, 2, 0, footerY); dissectBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	dissectBtn.ZIndex = Z + 1; dissectBtn.Parent = dialog
	addCorner(dissectBtn, UDim.new(0, 4)); W.addStroke(dissectBtn); table.insert(_themed.blobs, dissectBtn)
	refs.DissectBtn = dissectBtn

	return refs
end

return InventoryDissectDialog

--[[
	InventoryImportDialog  -  Part-Icles V5
	Copyright (C) 2026 Qwinkle
	Builds the Export/Import JSON dialog UI for local inventory.
	Returns refs table for wiring.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local W = require(script.Parent.Widgets)
local T = C.T

local DIALOG_W, DIALOG_H = 320, 280
local Z = 50 -- high ZIndex to be on top of everything

-- Alias canonical Widgets.addCorner.
local addCorner = W.addCorner

local InventoryImportDialog = {}

function InventoryImportDialog.build(sg)
	local refs = {}
	local _themed = W.getThemed()

	-- Modal backdrop (blocks clicks to everything behind, closes dialog)
	local backdrop = Instance.new("TextButton"); backdrop.Name = "InvImportBackdrop"
	backdrop.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0,0,0); backdrop.BackgroundTransparency = 0.7
	backdrop.Text = ""; backdrop.AutoButtonColor = false; backdrop.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0); backdrop.ZIndex = Z - 1
	backdrop.Visible = false; backdrop.Parent = sg; backdrop.BorderSizePixel = 0
	refs.InvImportBackdrop = backdrop

	-- Main dialog frame
	local dialog = Instance.new("Frame"); dialog.Name = "InvImportDialog"
	dialog.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg; dialog.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	dialog.Size = UDim2.new(0, DIALOG_W, 0, DIALOG_H)
	dialog.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5); dialog.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
	dialog.Visible = false; dialog.ZIndex = Z; dialog.ClipsDescendants = true
	dialog:SetAttribute("_noSnap", true); dialog.Parent = sg
	-- Modal dialog should stay fully readable rather than picking up the global panel translucency.
	dialog:SetAttribute("_opaquePanel", true)
	addCorner(dialog, T.BigCorner); W.addStroke(dialog); table.insert(_themed.panels, dialog)
	W.attachPanelBackground(dialog)
	local dp = Instance.new("UIPadding"); dp.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10); dp.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10)
	dp.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 6); dp.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 8); dp.Parent = dialog
	refs.InvImportDialog = dialog

	-- Header
	local header = Instance.new("Frame"); header.Name = "Header"; header.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20); header.ZIndex = Z + 1; header.Parent = dialog
	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel"); title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Text = "Export / Import Local Inventory"; title.TextColor3 = T.Gold
	title.Font = T.Font; title.TextSize = 11; title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, 0); title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0, 0)
	title.ZIndex = Z + 1; title.Parent = header
	local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton"); closeBtn.Name = "Close"; closeBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	closeBtn.Text = "X"; closeBtn.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; closeBtn.Font = T.Font; closeBtn.TextSize = 10
	closeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16); closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 0)
	closeBtn.ZIndex = Z + 1; closeBtn.Parent = header
	refs.InvImportClose = closeBtn
	local dragH = Instance.new("TextButton"); dragH.BackgroundTransparency = 1; dragH.Text = ""
	dragH.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, 0); dragH.ZIndex = Z + 1; dragH.Parent = header
	W.makeDraggable(dialog, dragH)

	-- Multiline text area
	local textWrap = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame"); textWrap.Name = "TextWrap"
	textWrap.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; textWrap.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
	textWrap.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -76); textWrap.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 24)
	textWrap.ScrollBarThickness = 3; textWrap.ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.ScrollBar
	textWrap.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0); textWrap.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	textWrap.BorderSizePixel = 0; textWrap.ZIndex = Z + 1; textWrap.Parent = dialog
	addCorner(textWrap, UDim.new(0, 4)); table.insert(_themed.blobs, textWrap); table.insert(_themed.scrollbars, textWrap)
	local textBox = Instance.new("TextBox"); textBox.Name = "TextBox"
	textBox.BackgroundTransparency = 1; textBox.Text = ""
	textBox.PlaceholderText = "Paste JSON here to import, or click Export..."
	textBox.PlaceholderColor3 = T.DarkGold; textBox.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold
	textBox.Font = T.BodyFont; textBox:SetAttribute("_noFontOverride", true); textBox.TextSize = 9; textBox.TextWrapped = true
	textBox.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; textBox.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
	textBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false; textBox.MultiLine = true
	textBox.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 0); textBox.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	textBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 4); textBox.ZIndex = Z + 1; textBox.Parent = textWrap
	refs.InvImportTextBox = textBox

	-- Button row
	local exportBtn = Instance.new("TextButton"); exportBtn.Name = "Export"
	exportBtn.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; exportBtn.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
	exportBtn.Text = "Export"; exportBtn.TextColor3 = T.Gold; exportBtn.Font = T.Font; exportBtn.TextSize = 10
	exportBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.48, 0, 0, 22); exportBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -44)
	exportBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0; exportBtn.ZIndex = Z + 1; exportBtn.Parent = dialog
	addCorner(exportBtn, UDim.new(0, 4)); W.addStroke(exportBtn); table.insert(_themed.blobs, exportBtn)
	refs.InvExportBtn = exportBtn

	local importBtn = Instance.new("TextButton"); importBtn.Name = "Import"
	importBtn.BackgroundColor3 = T.Green; importBtn.Text = "Import"
	importBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1); importBtn.Font = T.Font; importBtn.TextSize = 10
	importBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.48, 0, 0, 22); importBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.52, 0, 1, -44)
	importBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0; importBtn.ZIndex = Z + 1; importBtn.Parent = dialog
	addCorner(importBtn, UDim.new(0, 4)); W.addStroke(importBtn)
	refs.InvImportBtn = importBtn

	-- Status label
	local status = Instance.new("TextLabel"); status.Name = "Status"; status.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	status.Text = ""; status.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold; status.Font = T.Font; status.TextSize = 9
	status.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16); status.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -18)
	status.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center; status.ZIndex = Z + 1; status.Parent = dialog
	refs.InvImportStatus = status

	return refs
end

return InventoryImportDialog

--[[
	InventoryPanel  -  Part-Icles V5
	Copyright (C) 2026 Qwinkle
	Builds the Inventory panel UI: sidebar, tabs, thumbnail grid, detail popup,
	loading/error states, tooltip, result count.
	Returns refs table for wiring.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local W = require(script.Parent.Widgets)
local T = C.T

local PANEL_W, PANEL_H = 600, 380
local SIDEBAR_W = 110
local TAB_H = 24
local SEARCH_H = 26
-- Detail panel width is defined inline (DETAIL_PANEL_W)

-- Alias canonical Widgets.addCorner.
local addCorner = W.addCorner

local InventoryPanel = {}

function InventoryPanel.build(sg)
	local refs = {}
	local _themed = W.getThemed()

	-- Main panel
	local panel = Instance.new("Frame"); panel.Name = "InventoryPanel"
	panel.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg; panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, PANEL_W, 0, PANEL_H); panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -PANEL_W/2, 0.2, 0)
	panel.Visible = false; panel.ClipsDescendants = true; panel.Active = true; panel.Parent = sg
	addCorner(panel, T.BigCorner); W.addStroke(panel)
	table.insert(_themed.panels, panel)
	-- Inventory uses a custom 3-layer background instead of the global sibling-overlay helper.
	-- Negative ZIndex on bg + image so default-ZIndex content (grid scroller, sidebar buttons,
	-- search input  -  anything that doesn't set ZIndex explicitly defaults to 1) still renders
	-- ON TOP without each content widget having to opt in. Layering, back to front:
	--   ImageLabel (ZIndex=-2)  -  BgImage at the very back.
	--   bg Frame   (ZIndex=-1)  -  theme color + (inverted) transparency. Sits IN FRONT of the
	--                  image so the image only shows through the bg's transparency.
	--   content    (ZIndex >= 1, defaults or explicit 10/25/50 etc.)
	local bg = Instance.new("Frame"); bg.Name = "Background"
	bg.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg; bg.BackgroundTransparency = T.PanelAlpha
	bg.BorderSizePixel = 0; bg.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0); bg.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	bg.ZIndex = -1; bg.Parent = panel
	table.insert(_themed.panels, bg)
	local bgImage = Instance.new("ImageLabel"); bgImage.Name = "PanelBackgroundImage"
	bgImage.BackgroundTransparency = 1; bgImage.BorderSizePixel = 0
	bgImage.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	bgImage.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0); bgImage.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	bgImage.ZIndex = -2; bgImage.Image = T.BgImage or ""
	bgImage.ImageTransparency = T.BgImageTransparency or 1
	bgImage.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch; bgImage.Parent = panel
	table.insert(_themed.panelImages, bgImage)
	refs.InventoryPanel = panel
	W.makeResizable(panel, 600, 40)


	-- Header
	local header = Instance.new("Frame"); header.Name = "Header"; header.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22); header.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 4); header.ZIndex = 10; header.Parent = panel
	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel"); title.BackgroundTransparency = 1; title.Text = "Inventory"
	title.TextColor3 = T.Gold; title.Font = T.Font; title.TextSize = 12
	title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 1, 0)
	title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0); title.Parent = header
	local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton"); closeBtn.Name = "Close"; closeBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	closeBtn.Text = "X"; closeBtn.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; closeBtn.Font = T.Font; closeBtn.TextSize = 11
	closeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 20, 1, 0); closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 0); closeBtn.ZIndex = 12; closeBtn.Parent = header
	refs.InventoryClose = closeBtn
	-- Drag handle
	local dragH = Instance.new("TextButton"); dragH.BackgroundTransparency = 1; dragH.Text = ""
	dragH.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 1, 0); dragH.ZIndex = 11; dragH.Parent = header
	W.makeDraggable(panel, dragH)

	local contentY = 28

	-- Search bar + result count + filter button
	local FILTER_W = 64; local SEARCH_GAP = 4
	local searchWrap = Instance.new("Frame"); searchWrap.Name = "Search"; searchWrap.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg
	-- Proportional Size so the frame reflows when the panel resizes. Width =
	-- total - sidebar offset - filter button - gap - right margin.
	searchWrap.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
	searchWrap.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(SIDEBAR_W + 8 + FILTER_W + SEARCH_GAP + 8), 0, SEARCH_H)
	searchWrap.Position = UDim2.new(0, SIDEBAR_W + 8, 0, contentY); searchWrap.Parent = panel
	addCorner(searchWrap, UDim.new(0, 4)); W.addStroke(searchWrap); table.insert(_themed.blobs, searchWrap)
	local searchBox = Instance.new("TextBox"); searchBox.Name = "SearchBox"; searchBox.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	searchBox.PlaceholderText = "Search..."; searchBox.Text = ""; searchBox.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold
	searchBox.PlaceholderColor3 = T.DarkGold; searchBox.Font = T.Font; searchBox.TextSize = 11
	searchBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false; searchBox.Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 1, 0); searchBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 0)
	searchBox.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; searchBox.Parent = searchWrap
	refs.InvSearch = searchBox
	local countLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel"); countLabel.Name = "ResultCount"; countLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	countLabel.Text = ""; countLabel.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; countLabel.Font = T.Font; countLabel.TextSize = 9
	countLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 52, 1, 0); countLabel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -54, 0, 0)
	countLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right; countLabel.Parent = searchWrap
	refs.InvResultCount = countLabel
	-- Filter dropdown button (right of search bar)
	local filterBtn = Instance.new("TextButton"); filterBtn.Name = "FilterBtn"
	filterBtn.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; filterBtn.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
	filterBtn.Text = "Filters \u{25BC}"; filterBtn.TextColor3 = T.Gold; filterBtn.Font = T.Font; filterBtn.TextSize = 10
	filterBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, FILTER_W, 0, SEARCH_H); filterBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	-- Anchor from the right edge so filterBtn reflows with the panel. filterBtn sits
	-- 8px from the right edge to match the trailing +8 in searchWrap's negative-
	-- offset calc, giving SEARCH_GAP between them.
	filterBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -(FILTER_W + 8), 0, contentY)
	filterBtn.Parent = panel; addCorner(filterBtn, UDim.new(0, 4)); W.addStroke(filterBtn); table.insert(_themed.blobs, filterBtn)
	refs.InvFilterBtn = filterBtn
	-- Filter dropdown list (hidden, positioned below button)  -  right-aligned with filterBtn.
	local FILTER_DROP_W = FILTER_W + 30
	local filterDrop = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame"); filterDrop.Name = "FilterDropdown"
	filterDrop.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg; filterDrop.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	filterDrop.Size = UDim2.new(0, FILTER_DROP_W, 0, 180)
	filterDrop.Position = UDim2.new(1, -(FILTER_DROP_W + 8), 0, contentY + SEARCH_H + 2)
	filterDrop.Visible = false; filterDrop.ZIndex = 30; filterDrop.BorderSizePixel = 0
	filterDrop.ScrollBarThickness = 3; filterDrop.ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.ScrollBar
	filterDrop.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0,0,0,0); filterDrop.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	filterDrop.Parent = panel; addCorner(filterDrop, UDim.new(0, 4)); W.addStroke(filterDrop)
	local fdl = Instance.new("UIListLayout"); fdl.Padding = UDim.new(0,1); fdl.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder; fdl.Parent = filterDrop
	local fdp = Instance.new("UIPadding"); fdp.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0,2); fdp.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0,2)
	fdp.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0,2); fdp.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0,2); fdp.Parent = filterDrop
	filterDrop:SetAttribute("_opaquePanel", true)
	table.insert(_themed.panels, filterDrop); table.insert(_themed.scrollbars, filterDrop)
	refs.InvFilterDropdown = filterDrop

	-- Tabs (All / Static / Flipbook / Favs / Recent)
	local tabY = contentY + SEARCH_H + 4
	local tabFrame = Instance.new("Frame"); tabFrame.Name = "Tabs"; tabFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	-- Proportional Size so tabs reflow on panel resize.
	tabFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(SIDEBAR_W + 20), 0, TAB_H); tabFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, SIDEBAR_W + 8, 0, tabY)
	tabFrame.Parent = panel
	local tl = Instance.new("UIListLayout"); tl.Padding = UDim.new(0, 3); tl.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
	tl.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder; tl.Parent = tabFrame
	local function makeTab(name, text, lo)
		local b = Instance.new("TextButton"); b.Name = name; b.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg
		b.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha; b.Text = text; b.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
		b.Font = T.Font; b.TextSize = 10; b.Size = UDim2.new(0, 55, 1, 0); b.LayoutOrder = lo
		b.BorderSizePixel = 0; b.AutoButtonColor = false; b.Parent = tabFrame; addCorner(b, UDim.new(0, 4))
		W.addStroke(b); table.insert(_themed.blobs, b); return b
	end
	refs.TabAll = makeTab("TabAll", "All", 0)
	refs.TabStatic = makeTab("TabStatic", "Static", 1)
	refs.TabFlipbook = makeTab("TabFlipbook", "Flipbook", 2)
	refs.TabFavourites = makeTab("TabFavourites", "\u{2605} Favs", 3)
	refs.TabRecents = makeTab("TabRecents", "Recent", 4)

	-- Sidebar (category list  -  collapsible sections built in wiring)
	local sidebarFrame = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame"); sidebarFrame.Name = "Sidebar"
	sidebarFrame.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; sidebarFrame.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
	-- Vertical proportional so sidebar height grows with the panel.
	sidebarFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, SIDEBAR_W, 1, -(contentY + 32))
	sidebarFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, contentY); sidebarFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	sidebarFrame.ScrollBarThickness = 3; sidebarFrame.ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.ScrollBar
	sidebarFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0); sidebarFrame.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	sidebarFrame.Parent = panel; addCorner(sidebarFrame, UDim.new(0, 4)); W.addStroke(sidebarFrame)
	table.insert(_themed.blobs, sidebarFrame); table.insert(_themed.scrollbars, sidebarFrame)
	local sl = Instance.new("UIListLayout"); sl.Padding = UDim.new(0, 1); sl.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder; sl.Parent = sidebarFrame
	local sp = Instance.new("UIPadding"); sp.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 3); sp.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 3)
	sp.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 2); sp.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 5); sp.Parent = sidebarFrame
	refs.InvSidebar = sidebarFrame
	-- Export/Import button pinned to bottom of sidebar area
	local eiBtn = Instance.new("TextButton"); eiBtn.Name = "ExportImport"
	eiBtn.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; eiBtn.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
	eiBtn.Text = "Export / Import"; eiBtn.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold; eiBtn.Font = T.Font; eiBtn.TextSize = 10
	eiBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, SIDEBAR_W - 8, 0, 20); eiBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	eiBtn.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1); eiBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 1, -6)
	eiBtn.Parent = panel; addCorner(eiBtn, UDim.new(0, 4)); W.addStroke(eiBtn); table.insert(_themed.blobs, eiBtn)
	refs.InvExportImportBtn = eiBtn

	-- Action toolbar (context-sensitive buttons, shown for local modes)
	local toolY = tabY + TAB_H + 4
	local toolFrame = Instance.new("Frame"); toolFrame.Name = "Toolbar"; toolFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	-- Proportional reflow on panel resize.
	toolFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(SIDEBAR_W + 20), 0, TAB_H); toolFrame.Visible = false
	toolFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, SIDEBAR_W + 8, 0, toolY); toolFrame.Parent = panel
	local ttl = Instance.new("UIListLayout"); ttl.Padding = UDim.new(0,3); ttl.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
	ttl.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder; ttl.Parent = toolFrame
	local function makeToolBtn(name, text, lo)
		local b = Instance.new("TextButton"); b.Name = name; b.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; b.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
		b.Text = text; b.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold; b.Font = T.Font; b.TextSize = 10
		b.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0); b.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
		b.LayoutOrder = lo; b.BorderSizePixel = 0; b.Parent = toolFrame; addCorner(b, UDim.new(0,4))
		local tbp = Instance.new("UIPadding"); tbp.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0,6); tbp.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0,6); tbp.Parent = b
		W.addStroke(b); table.insert(_themed.blobs, b); return b
	end
	refs.InvToolbar = toolFrame
	refs.InvToolImport = makeToolBtn("Import", "Import Selected", 0)
	-- Import options arrow (opens dropdown with Bundle/Paths toggles)
	local impArrow = Instance.new("TextButton"); impArrow.Name = "ImportArrow"
	impArrow.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; impArrow.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
	impArrow.Text = "\u{25BC}"; impArrow.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold; impArrow.Font = T.Font; impArrow.TextSize = 8
	impArrow.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 1, 0); impArrow.LayoutOrder = 1; impArrow.BorderSizePixel = 0; impArrow.Parent = toolFrame
	addCorner(impArrow, UDim.new(0, 4)); W.addStroke(impArrow); table.insert(_themed.blobs, impArrow)
	refs.InvImportArrow = impArrow
	-- Import options dropdown (parented to panel, not toolbar, so it renders above grid)
	local impDrop = Instance.new("Frame"); impDrop.Name = "ImportDropdown"; impDrop.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg
	impDrop.BackgroundTransparency = 0; impDrop.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 0); impDrop.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	impDrop.Position = UDim2.new(0, SIDEBAR_W + 8, 0, 0); impDrop.ZIndex = 50 -- Y set dynamically by wiring
	impDrop.Active = true; impDrop.Visible = false; impDrop.Parent = panel
	impDrop:SetAttribute("_opaquePanel", true) -- exclude from panel transparency
	addCorner(impDrop, UDim.new(0, 4)); W.addStroke(impDrop); table.insert(_themed.panels, impDrop)
	local idly = Instance.new("UIListLayout"); idly.Padding = UDim.new(0, 1); idly.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder; idly.Parent = impDrop
	local idpad = Instance.new("UIPadding"); idpad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 4); idpad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 4)
	idpad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4); idpad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 4); idpad.Parent = impDrop
	local function makeImportOpt(name, text, lo)
		local o = Instance.new("TextButton"); o.Name = name; o.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg
		o.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha; o.Text = text; o.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
		o.Font = T.Font; o.TextSize = 10; o.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20); o.LayoutOrder = lo
		o.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; o.BorderSizePixel = 0; o.ZIndex = 51; o.Parent = impDrop
		addCorner(o, UDim.new(0, 3)); table.insert(_themed.blobs, o)
		local op = Instance.new("UIPadding"); op.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 6); op.Parent = o; return o
	end
	refs.InvOptBundle = makeImportOpt("Bundle", "\u{2610} Bundle (import as one)", 0)
	refs.InvOptPaths = makeImportOpt("Paths", "\u{2610} Paths (save locations)", 1)
	refs.InvImportDropdown = impDrop
	refs.InvToolUpload = makeToolBtn("Upload", "Upload", 2)
	refs.InvToolDissect = makeToolBtn("Dissect", "Dissect", 3)
	-- Thumbnail grid
	local gridY = toolY + 24; local gridFrame = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame"); gridFrame.Name = "Grid"
	gridFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1; gridFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	-- Proportional reflow  -  grid stretches with panel for both width AND height.
	gridFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(SIDEBAR_W + 20), 1, -(gridY + 8))
	gridFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, SIDEBAR_W + 8, 0, gridY)
	gridFrame.ScrollBarThickness = 4; gridFrame.ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.ScrollBar

--[[

	Snapshot-preview-apply flow (handled in RandomizerWiring):
	  Open  -> QOL.snapshotItem per item
	  Roll  -> per-item per-prop derive() + roll() + RandomizerWriter.write()
	  Apply -> ChangeHistory waypoint, drop snapshots
	  Cancel -> QOL.restoreSnapshots(snapshots), close
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local W = require(script.Parent.Widgets)
local T = C.T

local RandomizerPanel = {}

-- Build the modal panel frame. Returns refs map: {panel, sectionList, rollAllBtn,
-- applyBtn, cancelBtn, headerCloseBtn}. headerCloseBtn is W.makeToolPanel's built-in
-- `Hd.Close` (re-exposed here so wiring can attach a Cancel handler  -  every close
-- path must route through wiring.cancel() to restore preview snapshots). Caller
-- wires the buttons via the RandomizerWiring companion module.
function RandomizerPanel.build(sg)
	-- Modal panel ~ same dimensions as InventoryPanel for visual consistency. _opaquePanel
	-- so it stays opaque when global panel translucency is set; _noSnap so it doesn't
	-- participate in resolveOverlap (modal-positioned in front of Properties panel).
	-- 220px width: rows are simple (label blob + toggle); 220 fits the longest prop
	-- names (e.g. "AccelerationTowardsInstance") with truncation as fallback.
	local panel = W.makeToolPanel(sg, "Randomize", 220, 400)
	panel:SetAttribute("_opaquePanel", true)
	panel:SetAttribute("_noSnap", true)
	panel.Visible = false  -- toolbar toggle controls visibility

	local refs = {panel = panel}

	-- W.makeToolPanel already installs an `Hd.Close` button that hides the panel via
	-- `panel.Visible = false`. We expose it as `headerCloseBtn` so the wiring layer
	-- can attach its own Cancel handler  -  ALL close paths must route through
	-- wiring.cancel() to restore preview snapshots.
	local hd = panel:FindFirstChild("Hd")
	if hd then refs.headerCloseBtn = hd:FindFirstChild("Close") end

	-- Section list (scrolling). Populated by RandomizerWiring.populateSections.
	local sectionList = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	sectionList.Name = "SectionList"
	sectionList.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	sectionList.BorderSizePixel = 0
	sectionList.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 26)
	sectionList.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 1, -56)
	sectionList.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	sectionList.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	sectionList.ScrollBarThickness = 2
	sectionList.ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.ScrollBar
	sectionList.Parent = panel
	W.addListLayout(sectionList, 4, Enum.FillDirection.Vertical)
	refs.sectionList = sectionList

	-- Placeholder shown only until RandomizerWiring.populateSections rebuilds the list
	-- (which destroys all TextLabel/Frame children of sectionList).
	local placeholder = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	placeholder.Name = "Placeholder"
	placeholder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	placeholder.Text = "Loading…"
	placeholder.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold
	placeholder.Font = T.Font
	placeholder.TextSize = 8
	placeholder.TextWrapped = true
	placeholder.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	placeholder.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
	placeholder.Parent = sectionList

	-- Three buttons evenly across the row.
	local btnRow = Instance.new("Frame")
	btnRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	btnRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 22)
	btnRow.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 1, -26)
	btnRow.Parent = panel
	W.addListLayout(btnRow, 2, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal)

	refs.rollAllBtn = W.makeButton("RandRoll", btnRow, "Roll", UDim2.new(1/3, -2, 1, 0))
	refs.rollAllBtn.LayoutOrder = 0
	refs.rollAllBtn.TextSize = 9
	refs.applyBtn = W.makeButton("RandApply", btnRow, "Apply", UDim2.new(1/3, -2, 1, 0), T.Gold)
	refs.applyBtn.LayoutOrder = 1
	refs.applyBtn.TextSize = 9
	refs.cancelBtn = W.makeButton("RandCancel", btnRow, "Cancel", UDim2.new(1/3, -2, 1, 0), T.DarkGold)
	refs.cancelBtn.LayoutOrder = 2
	refs.cancelBtn.TextSize = 9

	return refs
end

return RandomizerPanel

--[[
	ShortcutPanel  -  Part-Icles V5 ShortcutKey System
	Copyright (C) 2026 Qwinkle

	Modal panel scaffolding for the Shortcuts UI. A separate panel (not a tab in
	Settings) opened by the "Shortcuts" button in Settings. Modal-ish: overlays
	Properties; closeable.

	Layout (configurable leader; chord shows as "<LEADER> + key" or bare chord when
	leader is (none)):
	  [ShortcutPanel  -  modal]
	  Desc: bind a chord, hold the leader to fire.
	  Leader: P            [Set] [(none)]    (leader-row; configurable)
	  [Search shortcuts...]                   (text filter)
	  [Unbind all]              [Close]       (header buttons)
	  ─────────────────────────────────────
	  ▼ UI
	    Toggle UI           (unbound)        [Bind] [X]
	    Toggle Inventory    P + I            [Bind] [X]   (after user binds it)
	    ...
	  ▼ Tools / Edit / Animate / Emit / Editor (collapsible per ActionCatalog category)

	Build returns refs map: {panel, scrollList, searchBox, resetBtn, headerCloseBtn,
	leaderLabel, leaderSetBtn, leaderClearBtn}.
	Capture-state UX, conflict warning, and save flow are wired by
	`Modules/Shortcuts/Wiring.luau` and the runtime in `Modules/Shortcuts/init.luau`.

	`implemented = true` filter applied at populate time so stub Action entries
	(ResetSelection, OpenGraphEditor, OpenColorPicker) don't appear in the bind list  - 
	users only see bindable actions.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local W = require(script.Parent.Widgets)
local T = C.T

local ShortcutPanel = {}

function ShortcutPanel.build(sg)
	-- 300x420  -  wider than RandomizerPanel because each row needs combo display + 2
	-- buttons. With nameBlob 130 + comboBlob -208 reserve + buttons 78 right gutter,
	-- 300 leaves ~120px for the combo display, enough for "P + Shift+X".
	local panel = W.makeToolPanel(sg, "Shortcuts", 300, 420)
	panel:SetAttribute("_opaquePanel", true)
	panel:SetAttribute("_noSnap", true)
	panel.Visible = false

	local refs = {panel = panel}

	-- Built-in header close from W.makeToolPanel; expose for wiring layer.
	local hd = panel:FindFirstChild("Hd")
	if hd then refs.headerCloseBtn = hd:FindFirstChild("Close") end

	-- Brief description. Leader-row below carries the rest of the context.
	local descBlob = W.makeBlob("PGuardDesc", panel, UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 22))
	descBlob.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 26)
	W.addPadding(descBlob, 6, 6, 4, 4)
	local desc = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	desc.Name = "DescText"
	desc.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	desc.Text = 'Bind a chord. Hold the leader (below) then tap the chord. Don\'t press the leader during capture.'
	desc.TextWrapped = false
	desc.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
	desc.Font = T.Font
	desc.TextSize = 9
	desc.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	desc.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	desc.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	desc.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	desc.Parent = descBlob

	-- Leader-row. "Leader: <KEY>  [Set] [(none)]". Capture flow + label refresh
	-- live in Modules/Shortcuts/Wiring.luau via the refs exposed here.
	local leaderRow = Instance.new("Frame")
	leaderRow.Name = "LeaderRow"
	leaderRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	leaderRow.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 52)
	leaderRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 22)
	leaderRow.Parent = panel

	local leaderBlob = W.makeBlob("LeaderBlob", leaderRow, UDim2.new(1, -132, 1, 0))
	leaderBlob.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	W.addPadding(leaderBlob, 6, 4, 0, 0)
	local leaderLabel = W.makeLabel("L", leaderBlob, "Leader: P", T.BrightGold, T.Font, 10)
	leaderLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	leaderLabel.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	refs.leaderLabel = leaderLabel

	local leaderSetBtn = W.makeButton("LeaderSet", leaderRow, "Set", UDim2.new(0, 56, 1, -4), T.DarkGold)
	leaderSetBtn.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	leaderSetBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -64, 0, 2)
	leaderSetBtn.TextSize = 10
	refs.leaderSetBtn = leaderSetBtn

	local leaderClearBtn = W.makeButton("LeaderClear", leaderRow, "(none)", UDim2.new(0, 56, 1, -4), T.DarkGold)
	leaderClearBtn.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	leaderClearBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 2)
	leaderClearBtn.TextSize = 10
	refs.leaderClearBtn = leaderClearBtn

	-- Search box (text filter). Filter logic lives in Modules/Shortcuts/Wiring.luau.
	local searchBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
	searchBox.Name = "ShortcutsSearch"
	searchBox.PlaceholderText = "Search shortcuts..."
	searchBox.Text = ""
	searchBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
	searchBox.Font = T.Font
	searchBox.TextSize = 9
	searchBox.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
	searchBox.PlaceholderColor3 = T.DarkGold
	searchBox.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg
	searchBox.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
	searchBox.BorderSizePixel = 0
	searchBox.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	searchBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 78)
	searchBox.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 18)
	searchBox.Parent = panel
	W.addCorner(searchBox, UDim.new(0, 3))
	W.addPadding(searchBox, 0, 0, 4, 4)
	refs.searchBox = searchBox

	-- Reset-all button. Two-click confirm flow wired by Modules/Shortcuts/Wiring.luau.
	local resetBtn = W.makeButton("ShortcutsReset", panel, "Unbind all", UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 18), T.DarkGold)
	resetBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 100)
	resetBtn.TextSize = 9
	refs.resetBtn = resetBtn

	-- Scrollable action list. Populated by Wiring from ctx.Actions filtered by
	-- `def.implemented == true`.
	local scrollList = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	scrollList.Name = "ShortcutsList"
	scrollList.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	scrollList.BorderSizePixel = 0
	scrollList.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 122)
	scrollList.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 1, -128)
	scrollList.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	scrollList.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	scrollList.ScrollBarThickness = 1
	scrollList.ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.ScrollBar
	scrollList.Parent = panel
	W.addListLayout(scrollList, 4, Enum.FillDirection.Vertical)
	refs.scrollList = scrollList

	-- Placeholder shown only until Wiring.populate replaces with per-category rows.
	local placeholder = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	placeholder.Name = "Placeholder"
	placeholder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	placeholder.Text = "Loading…"
	placeholder.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold
	placeholder.Font = T.Font
	placeholder.TextSize = 8
	placeholder.TextWrapped = true
	placeholder.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	placeholder.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
	placeholder.Parent = scrollList

	return refs
end

return ShortcutPanel

children.source:
-- UIToolPanels  -  Part-Icles V5. Copyright (C) 2026 Qwinkle
-- QOL tool panel builders: QMenu, Resize, Retime, Clipboard, Shifter, FixBanner.
-- Reads clipboard descriptors from TypeRegistry where possible (PE lists stay hardcoded).

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local W = require(script.Parent.Widgets)
local PropertyCatalog = require(script.Parent.Parent.PropertyCatalog)
local T = C.T
local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT

local ToolPanels = {}

-- Display name overrides: raw property key → friendly UI label (for clipboard/shifter toggles)
local DISPLAY_NAMES = {
	PartLife="Linger", TotalKeyFrames="Anim. Steps", ShapePartial="Hollow",
	VelocityVectored="Dir. Relative", InvertMotion="Reverse Motion", RotMode="Rotation Mode",
	RotSpeedX="Rot Speed X", RotSpeedY="Rot Speed Y", RotSpeedZ="Rot Speed Z",
	RotX="Rot X", RotY="Rot Y", RotZ="Rot Z", EmissionDirection="Direction",
	FlipbookMode="Flipbook Mode", FlipbookFramerate="Framerate",
	FlipbookStartRandom="Start Random", FlipbookReverse="Reverse",
	LightEmission="Light Emission", LightInfluence="Light Influence",
	TextureLength="Tex. Length", TextureSpeed="Tex. Speed", TextureMode="Tex. Mode",
	SizeX="Size X", SizeY="Size Y", SizeZ="Size Z", RotSpeed="Rot Speed",
	PosOffsetX="Displacement X", PosOffsetY="Displacement Y", PosOffsetZ="Displacement Z",
	DisplacementMode="Displacement Mode",
}
ToolPanels.DISPLAY_NAMES = DISPLAY_NAMES

-- Search box helper for Clipboard/Shifter panels
local function _makeSearchBox(parent, yPos)
	local sb = W.makeBlob("Search", parent, UDim2.new(1,0,0,18)); sb.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,yPos)
	local box = Instance.new("TextBox"); box.BackgroundTransparency = 1; box.PlaceholderText = "Search..."
	box.Text = ""; box.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold; box.PlaceholderColor3 = T.DarkGold; box.Font = T.Font; box.TextSize = 9
	box.ClearTextOnFocus = false; box.Size = UDim2.new(1,-4,1,0); box.Position = UDim2.new(0,2,0,0)
	box.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; box.BorderSizePixel = 0; box.Parent = sb; return box
end

-- Word-boundary match: start of label or after space/underscore. Query escaped against
-- Luau pattern specials so chars like `(`, `.`, `%`, `[`, `*` match literally.
local function _escapePattern(s) return (s:gsub("[%(%)%.%%%+%-%*%?%[%]%^%$]", "%%%1")) end
local function _labelMatches(label, q)
	local esc = _escapePattern(q)
	return label:sub(1, #q) == q or label:find("[%s_]" .. esc) ~= nil
end

-- Wire search filtering on a scroll frame (call after building toggles).
-- External code (selection-filter, type-toggles) calls
-- `ToolPanels.invalidateSearchSnapshot(searchBox)` when it changes visibility while
-- a search is active. The next clear-search re-snapshots from post-filter state
-- instead of restoring stale pre-filter visibility (which would undo the filter).
function ToolPanels.invalidateSearchSnapshot(searchBox)
	if searchBox then searchBox:SetAttribute("_savedDirty", true) end
end

function ToolPanels.wireSearch(searchBox, scrollFrame)
	if not searchBox or not scrollFrame then return end
	local _saved = {} -- {[frame] = wasVisible} snapshot before search (bodies + rows)
	searchBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
		local query = searchBox.Text:lower()
		local isSearch = query ~= ""
		-- If external code (filter toggle) marked the snapshot dirty, drop it and
		-- re-snapshot from current state. Otherwise clearing search would restore
		-- stale pre-filter visibility and undo the filter's just-applied changes.
		if searchBox:GetAttribute("_savedDirty") then
			_saved = {}
			searchBox:SetAttribute("_savedDirty", nil)
		end
		-- Save state on first search (bodies + rows from selection filter)
		if isSearch and next(_saved) == nil then
			for _, d in ipairs(scrollFrame:GetDescendants()) do
				if d:IsA("Frame") and (d.Name == "Body" or d:GetAttribute("PropRow") or d.Name:match("Section$") or d.Name:match("Sub$")) then _saved[d] = d.Visible end
			end
			for _, s in ipairs(scrollFrame:GetChildren()) do if s:IsA("Frame") then _saved[s] = s.Visible end end
		end
		if isSearch then
			local hits = {}
			for _, d in ipairs(scrollFrame:GetDescendants()) do
				if d:IsA("Frame") and d:GetAttribute("PropRow") then
					local lbl = d:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel")
					if lbl then
						local match = _saved[d] and _labelMatches(lbl.Text:lower(), query)
						d.Visible = match or false
						if match then local c = d.Parent; while c and c ~= scrollFrame do hits[c] = true; c = c.Parent end end
					end
				end
			end
			for _, d in ipairs(scrollFrame:GetDescendants()) do
				if d:IsA("Frame") and (d.Name:match("Section$") or d.Name:match("Sub$")) then d.Visible = hits[d] or false
				elseif d.Name == "Body" and d:IsA("Frame") then d.Visible = hits[d] or false end
			end
			for _, s in ipairs(scrollFrame:GetChildren()) do if s:IsA("Frame") then s.Visible = hits[s] or false end end
		else
			for d, vis in pairs(_saved) do d.Visible = vis end; _saved = {}
		end
		-- Sync arrows
		for _, d in ipairs(scrollFrame:GetDescendants()) do
			local hdr = d:IsA("Frame") and d:FindFirstChild("Header")
			if hdr then local ar = hdr:FindFirstChild("Arrow"); if ar then
				local body = d:FindFirstChild("Body"); if body then ar.Text = body.Visible and "\u{25BC}" or "\u{25B6}" end
			end end
		end
	end)
end

-- PE props are hardcoded (not in TypeRegistry  -  PE is native Roblox)
-- Exposed via ToolPanels.PE_SECTIONS so RandomizerWiring (and future PropertyCatalog
-- consumers) can pass the same PE section list that Clipboard uses.
ToolPanels.PE_SECTIONS = nil
local PE_SECTIONS = {
	{name = "Spawning", props = {"Rate", "Lifetime", "SpreadAngle"}},
	{name = "Emission", props = {"EmitCount", "EmitDelay", "EmitDuration"}},
	{name = "Appearance", props = {"Brightness", "Size", "Transparency", "Color", "Squash", "LightEmission", "LightInfluence", "ZOffset"}},
	{name = "Movement", props = {"Speed", "RotSpeed", "Rotation", "Acceleration", "Drag", "VelocityInheritance", "TimeScale", "WindAffectsDrag"}},
	{name = "Flipbook", props = {"FlipbookFramerate", "FlipbookBlendFrames"}},
}
local PE_SECTIONS_SHIFTER = {
	{name = "Spawning", props = {"Rate", "Lifetime", "SpreadAngle"}},
	{name = "Emission", props = {"EmitCount", "EmitDelay", "EmitDuration"}},
	{name = "Appearance", props = {"Brightness", "Size", "Transparency", "Squash", "LightEmission", "LightInfluence", "ZOffset"}},
	{name = "Movement", props = {"Speed", "RotSpeed", "Rotation", "Acceleration", "Drag", "VelocityInheritance", "TimeScale"}},
	{name = "Flipbook", props = {"FlipbookFramerate"}},
}
ToolPanels.PE_SECTIONS = PE_SECTIONS

-- Type-name + ctx-field-key constants live in PropertyCatalog (single source of truth).
-- ToolPanels reads via the local alias below; ClipShiftFix reads via
-- `ToolPanels.TYPE_ITEM_KEYS` which we re-expose for backwards compat.
local TYPE_ITEM_KEYS = PropertyCatalog.TYPE_ITEM_KEYS

-- Forwarding shim: body lives in `Modules/PropertyCatalog`. Same return shape.
local function _mergeClipboards(TypeRegistry, peSections, excludeProps)
	return PropertyCatalog.merge(TypeRegistry, peSections, excludeProps)
end

-- Cached maps (populated during build, accessed by ClipShiftFix via ToolPanels.propTypeMap)
ToolPanels.propTypeMap = {}; ToolPanels.propTypeMapShifter = {}; ToolPanels.TYPE_ITEM_KEYS = TYPE_ITEM_KEYS

-- ==================== Q MENU ====================
function ToolPanels.buildQMenu(sg)
	local panel = Instance.new("Frame"); panel.Name = "QMenu"
	panel.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg; panel.BackgroundTransparency = T.PanelAlpha
	panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
	-- Offset left of the Settings panel (SettingsWidth=200 + 12 right margin + 8 gap)
	-- so Tools doesn't overlap Settings when both are open at default positions.
	panel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -(LAYOUT.SettingsWidth + 12 + 8 + 12), 1, -40)
	local QMENU_H = 277  -- 237 base + 20 for Randomize + 20 for Forge Convert
	panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, LAYOUT.HudWidth, 0, QMENU_H)
	panel.ClipsDescendants = true; panel.Active = true; panel.Visible = false; panel.Parent = sg
	W.addCorner(panel, T.BigCorner); W.addStroke(panel); W.addPadding(panel,4,4,4,4); W.addListLayout(panel,3)
	table.insert(W.getThemed().panels, panel)
	W.attachPanelBackground(panel)
	local db = W.makeBlob("Drag", panel, UDim2.new(1,0,0,22)); db.LayoutOrder = 0
	local dt = Instance.new("TextLabel"); dt.BackgroundTransparency = 1; dt.Text = "Tools"; dt.TextColor3 = T.Gold; dt.Font = T.Font; dt.TextSize = 11; dt.Size = UDim2.new(1,-18,1,0)
	dt.Position = UDim2.new(0,4,0,0); dt.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; dt.Parent = db
	local qClose = Instance.new("TextButton"); qClose.Name = "Close"; qClose.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	qClose.Text = "X"; qClose.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; qClose.Font = T.Font; qClose.TextSize = 10
	qClose.Size = UDim2.new(0,14,1,0); qClose.Position = UDim2.new(1,-14,0,0); qClose.ZIndex = 3; qClose.Parent = db
	qClose.Activated:Connect(function() panel.Visible = false end)
	local dh = Instance.new("TextButton"); dh.BackgroundTransparency = 1; dh.Text = ""
	dh.Size = UDim2.new(1,-18,1,0); dh.ZIndex = 2; dh.Parent = db; W.makeDraggable(panel, dh)
	local refs = {}; local bodyItems = {}
	for i, name in ipairs({"Resize","Retime","Hue","Clipboard","Shifter","Randomize","Scan","Insert","EmitCode","ForgeConvert"}) do
		refs[name] = W.makeButton("Q_"..name, panel, name, UDim2.new(1,0,0,20), T.MutedGold)
		refs[name].TextSize = 10; refs[name].LayoutOrder = i; table.insert(bodyItems, refs[name])
	end
	refs.Insert.Text = "Insert Module"; refs.Scan.Text = "Scan All"; refs.EmitCode.Text = "Emit Code"
	refs.ForgeConvert.Text = "Convert from Forge"

	refs.OptToggle = W.makeButton("Q_Opt", panel, "Opt. Indicator", UDim2.new(1,0,0,20), T.MutedGold)
	refs.OptToggle.TextSize = 10; refs.OptToggle.LayoutOrder = 8; refs.OptToggle:SetAttribute("IsOn", false)
	refs.OptToggle.Activated:Connect(function()
		local isOn = not refs.OptToggle:GetAttribute("IsOn"); refs.OptToggle:SetAttribute("IsOn", isOn)
		refs.OptToggle.TextColor3 = isOn and T.Gold or T.MutedGold
	end)
	table.insert(bodyItems, refs.OptToggle)

	W.addCollapseButton(db, bodyItems, {
		panel = panel, expandedSize = UDim2.new(0, LAYOUT.HudWidth, 0, QMENU_H),
		collapsedSize = UDim2.new(0, LAYOUT.HudWidth, 0, 30),
	})
	refs.QMenu = panel; refs.QMenuClose = qClose; return refs
end

-- =========================================================
-- RESIZE
-- =========================================================
function ToolPanels.buildResize(sg)
	local panel = W.makeToolPanel(sg, "Resize", 120, 128)
	local refs = {}
	local sl, vd, sv, gv = W.makeSlider(panel, 0.5, 2, 1, nil, "%.2fx", true)
	sl.Position = UDim2.new(0,5,0,22); sl.Size = UDim2.new(1,-10,0,28)
	refs.ResizeGetVal = gv; refs.ResizeSetVal = sv; refs.ResizeInput = vd

	local adRow = Instance.new("Frame"); adRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	adRow.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,14); adRow.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,52); adRow.Parent = panel
	local adLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel"); adLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1; adLbl.Text = "Include Descendants"
	adLbl.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; adLbl.Font = T.Font; adLbl.TextSize = 8; adLbl.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	adLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1,-34,1,0); adLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,0); adLbl.Parent = adRow
	refs.ResizeDescToggle = W.makeToggle("ResDesc", adRow); refs.ResizeDescToggle.Position = UDim2.new(1,-30,0,-1)
	-- Default to ON  -  users nearly always want descendants included when resizing containers
	refs.ResizeDescToggle:SetAttribute("IsOn", true); refs.ResizeDescToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40,55,30)
	local rDot = refs.ResizeDescToggle:FindFirstChild("Dot"); if rDot then rDot.BackgroundColor3 = T.Green; rDot.Position = UDim2.new(0,14,0,2) end

	local ssRow = Instance.new("Frame"); ssRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	ssRow.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,14); ssRow.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,68); ssRow.Parent = panel
	local ssLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel"); ssLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1; ssLbl.Text = "Scale Spawn Area"
	ssLbl.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; ssLbl.Font = T.Font; ssLbl.TextSize = 8
	ssLbl.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd; ssLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1,-34,1,0); ssLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,0); ssLbl.Parent = ssRow
	refs.ResizeScaleShapeToggle = W.makeToggle("ResShape", ssRow); refs.ResizeScaleShapeToggle.Position = UDim2.new(1,-30,0,-1)

	local btnRow = Instance.new("Frame"); btnRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1

	-- Build unified categories for shifter. Exclusions: booleans, enums, strings, ColorSequences,
	-- and Events (each event is a snapshot tree, not a numeric value to shift).
	-- Vector2 / Vector3 / UDim2 are shiftable component-wise (see QOL._opVec2 / _opVec3 / _opUDim2).
	local mergedS, ptmS = _mergeClipboards(TypeRegistry, PE_SECTIONS_SHIFTER, {
		Blender = true,
		-- Booleans (not mathematically operable)
		FlipbookReverse = true, VelocityVectored = true, InvertMotion = true, FaceCamera = true, FlipbookStartRandom = true,
		UseShape = true, LookAtInitially = true, Enabled = true, Shadows = true,

		ScaleTextureLength = true,
		RotXEven = true, RotYEven = true, RotZEven = true,
		PosXEven = true, PosYEven = true, PosZEven = true,
		-- Enums / string modes (not mathematically operable)
		EmissionDirection = true, Material = true, RotMode = true, RotOrder = true, PosMode = true, DirMode = true, DisplacementMode = true,
		Shape = true, ShapeInOut = true, Orientation = true,
		TextureMode = true, FlipbookMode = true, FlipbookSource = true, ScaleType = true, ResampleMode = true,
		-- Events (per-event snapshot tree  -  not numeric).
		OnEmit = true, OnDeath = true, OnDestruction = true, OnHit = true,
		-- ColorSequences (explicitly skipped in shiftItems)
		Color = true, Decay = true, TintColor = true, ImageColor3 = true, BackgroundColor3 = true,
		-- string / ContentId  -  ImageLabel's Image asset ID isn't numeric. Trail Duration
		-- is a string-formatted NumberRange ("min, max") with directAccess; can't shift directly.
		Image = true, Duration = true,
	})

	refs.ShifterPanel = panel; refs.ShifterScroll = sc; return refs
end

-- HUE CHANGER
-- =========================================================
function ToolPanels.buildHueChanger(sg)
	local panel = W.makeToolPanel(sg, "HueChanger", 80, 360)
	local refs = {}
	local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	local HANDLE_H = 8

	-- Builds a vertical slider with gradient background. Returns (getVal, setVal, track)
	-- xScale: 0-1 horizontal position (Scale-based for responsive layout)
	local function makeVSlider(parent, xScale, gradient, minVal, maxVal, defaultVal)
		local track = Instance.new("Frame"); track.Name = "Track"; track.BorderSizePixel = 0
		track.Size = UDim2.new(0.2, 0, 1, -90); track.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
		track.Position = UDim2.new(xScale, 0, 0, 26)
		track.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1); track.Parent = parent
		local cr = Instance.new("UICorner"); cr.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,4); cr.Parent = track
		local gr = Instance.new("UIGradient"); gr.Rotation = 90; gr.Parent = track
		gr.Color = gradient
		local handle = Instance.new("Frame"); handle.Name = "Handle"; handle.BorderSizePixel = 0
		handle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1); handle.Size = UDim2.new(1,4,0,HANDLE_H)
		handle.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5,0.5); handle.Position = UDim2.new(0.5,0,0.5,0)
		handle.ZIndex = 3; handle.Parent = track
		local hc = Instance.new("UICorner"); hc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,3); hc.Parent = handle
		local hs = Instance.new("UIStroke"); hs.Color = Color3.new(0,0,0); hs.Thickness = 1; hs.Parent = handle
		local cur = defaultVal; local dragging = false
		local lo, hi = math.min(minVal, maxVal), math.max(minVal, maxVal)
		local function setVal(v, skip)
			cur = math.clamp(v, lo, hi)
			local t = (cur - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal)
			handle.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, t, 0)
		end
		local function getVal() return cur end
		local btn = Instance.new("TextButton"); btn.BackgroundTransparency = 1; btn.Text = ""
		btn.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0); btn.ZIndex = 4; btn.Parent = track
		btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
			if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = true end
		end)
		btn.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
			if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = false end
		end)
		local uisC = W.getUISConnections()
		table.insert(uisC, UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
			if not dragging or i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then return end
			local absY = track.AbsolutePosition.Y; local absH = track.AbsoluteSize.Y
			local rel = math.clamp((i.Position.Y - absY) / absH, 0, 1)
			setVal(minVal + rel * (maxVal - minVal))
		end))
		table.insert(uisC, UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
			if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = false end
		end))
		btn.Activated:Connect(function()
			local m = UIS:GetMouseLocation(); local absY = track.AbsolutePosition.Y; local absH = track.AbsoluteSize.Y
			local rel = math.clamp((m.Y - absY) / absH, 0, 1)
			setVal(minVal + rel * (maxVal - minVal))
		end)
		setVal(defaultVal)
		return getVal, setVal, track
	end

	-- Rainbow gradient for Hue
	local hueGrad = ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromHSV(0,1,1)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.167, Color3.fromHSV(0.167,1,1)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.333, Color3.fromHSV(0.333,1,1)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromHSV(0.5,1,1)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.667, Color3.fromHSV(0.667,1,1)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.833, Color3.fromHSV(0.833,1,1)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromHSV(0,1,1)),
	})
	-- Saturation: white → full color (red as reference)
	local satGrad = ColorSequence.new({ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.new(1,1,1)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromHSV(0,1,1))})
	-- Value: white → black
	local valGrad = ColorSequence.new({ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.new(1,1,1)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.new(0,0,0))})

	local hgv, hsv = makeVSlider(panel, 1/6, hueGrad, -0.5, 0.5, 0)
	local sgv, ssv = makeVSlider(panel, 3/6, satGrad, -1, 1, 0)
	local vgv, vsv = makeVSlider(panel, 5/6, valGrad, 1, -1, 0)

	-- Labels (below tracks, same Scale X positions)
	local function addLabel(text, xScale)
		local l = Instance.new("TextLabel"); l.BackgroundTransparency = 1; l.Text = text
		l.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold; l.Font = T.Font; l.TextSize = 7; l.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		l.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0); l.Size = UDim2.new(0.2, 0, 0, 10)
		l.Position = UDim2.new(xScale, 0, 1, -62); l.Parent = panel
	end
	addLabel("H", 1/6); addLabel("S", 3/6); addLabel("V", 5/6)

	-- Apply / Reset buttons
	local btnRow = Instance.new("Frame"); btnRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	btnRow.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,20); btnRow.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,1,-24); btnRow.Parent = panel
	W.addListLayout(btnRow, 2, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal)
	refs.HueApply = W.makeButton("Ap", btnRow, "Apply", UDim2.new(0.5,-1,1,0)); refs.HueApply.LayoutOrder = 0; refs.HueApply.TextSize = 9
	refs.HueReset = W.makeButton("Rs", btnRow, "Reset", UDim2.new(0.5,-1,1,0), T.DarkGold); refs.HueReset.LayoutOrder = 1; refs.HueReset.TextSize = 9

	refs.HueGetVal = hgv; refs.HueSetVal = hsv
	refs.SatGetVal = sgv; refs.SatSetVal = ssv
	refs.ValGetVal = vgv; refs.ValSetVal = vsv
	refs.HuePanel = panel; return refs
end

	refs.FixDismiss.Activated:Connect(function() banner.Visible = false end)

	refs.FixBanner = banner

function ToolPanels.buildEmitCode(sg)

	local refs = {}
	-- Code display (multiline, monospace, read-only feel)
	local codeWrap = Instance.new("Frame"); codeWrap.Name = "CodeWrap"
